• Using the fairy ring (code fairy ring BLS) and running north-east towards the bridge and continue into the swamp
• The skills necklace or Farming cape provide teleports to the Farming Guild then running south through the River Molch towards Xeric's Shrine, then continue south

Kebos Swamp.title: Kebos Swamp
Kebos Swamp.transport:
The Kebos Swamp is a swamp located in the Kebos Lowlands north of Mount Quidamortem. Here, players can find the lizardman village of Molch, as well as Xeric's Shrine.

To the west of the swamp is the Kebos Lowlands mine, as well as a small hunter area containing crimson swifts. Here, players can find Ket'sal K'uk, a lizardman shaman, worshipping a fire in the centre of a stone circle.

The Dwarf multicannon cannot be used here. If attempted, you receive the message, "There's something in the swampy atmosphere that interferes with your cannon."

Battlefront.title: Battlefront
Battlefront.transport:
The Battlefront is a large battlefield just outside the western border of Great Kourend. It is where the majority of Shayzien soldiers fight the lizardmen to keep Kourend safe. Players can reach the Battlefront by casting Battlefront Teleport, or running south-east from the fairy ring (code fairy ring CIR).

The army here consists of soldiers, rangers and doyens led by General Vir, with Lovakengj Engineers helping to keep the siege weapons running. In addition, they have one on-field nurse, Nurse Emma Gentsy, next to Vir's quarters in the north side. An ancient grave is located by the fountain

Molch.title: Molch
Molch.transport:
Molch is a small settlement found in the Kebos Swamp, a swamp in the Kebos Lowlands. It is inhabited by lizardmen. A lizardman shaman named Ek'ans Chan can be seen chanting. In addition, two enclosures containing unattackable swamp frogs can be found, suggesting the lizardmen use them as a source of food.

A can be found here with an altar dedicated to Xeric. In addition, there are four entrances to the Lizardman Temple, containing six lizardman shamans in a single-way combat area.

A quick way to travel to Molch is to use a Skills necklace to teleport to the Farming Guild and run south across

Lizardman Canyon.title: Lizardman Canyon
Lizardman Canyon.transport:
The Lizardman Canyon is a valley in the west portion of Great Kourend, between Lovakengj and Shayzien. The valley is where lizardmen and lizardman brutes reside, and is the responsibility of the Shayzien soldiers to keep them contained.

A wounded soldier overlooking both canyons can inform players of how many people are inside either canyon.

The easiest way to get there is by using the fairy ring with the code fairy ring DJR.

Mynydd.title: Mynydd
Mynydd.transport:
Mynydd is a lone mountain located just north-west of Prifddinas. It is dotted with dead trees, and towers over the small village of Gwenith. It is also the only mountain in Tirannwn aside from the Arandar mountain pass.

In order to reach the mountain, players must travel to its base in the south-west. There is no other way to ascend the mountain.

The book Legends of the Mountain provides the player with three local folktales about Mynydd.

Lava Maze Dungeon.title: Lava Maze Dungeon
Lava Maze Dungeon.transport:
The Lava Maze Dungeon is a dungeon beneath the Lava Maze in high level Wilderness. The dungeon is entirely single-way combat and has two ladder entrances.

The dungeon's western entrance is west of the Lava Maze, level 42 Wilderness in a metal fenced area containing lesser demons. This entrance leads to a small area containing only poison spiders and the lever to enter the King Black Dragon's lair. This part of the dungeon covers level 42 to 43 Wilderness.

The dungeon's eastern entrance is in the centre of the Lava Maze, level 42 to 43 Wilderness in a metal fenced area. This entrance leads to

Evil Chicken's Lair.title: Evil Chicken's Lair
Evil Chicken's Lair.transport:
The Evil Chicken's Lair is located on Zanaris and is accessed by using a raw chicken on the Chicken Shrine. Undead raw chicken does not work.

It is accessible during and after the Recipe for Disaster subquest Freeing Sir Amik Varze during which players must kill the Evil Chicken. To be able to access the Evil Chicken's Lair, the player must have spoken to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village after speaking to the Cook to learn Sir Amik Varze's recipe.

The area can be exited via the portal, which takes you next to the chicken shrine.

Corsair Cove Dungeon.title: Corsair Cove Dungeon
Corsair Cove Dungeon.transport:
• Talk to Cabin Boy Colin on the western end of Rimmington after completion of The Corsair Curse, or Captain Tock during the quest. This is the only way to access the island in free-to-play worlds.
• Spirit tree teleport to Feldip Hills and run east.
• Charter ship to Corsair Cove.
• Mythical cape teleport to the Myths' Guild.

King Black Dragon Lair.title: King Black Dragon Lair
King Black Dragon Lair.transport:
The King Black Dragon Lair, abbreviated as the KBD lair, is a multi-combat area, allowing groups of players to fight him simultaneously. The lair can be accessed via the western entrance to the Lava Maze Dungeon in level 42 Wilderness near the Lava Maze, however the lair itself is not the Wilderness. The lair is additionally visited by players completing an elite or master clue scroll step; the elite one requires players to kill the dragon, while the master clue has an emote clue that must be performed in the cave.

• Watch out for player-killers on the way to the lair. The dungeon may be acce

Jormungand's Prison.title: Jormungand's Prison
Jormungand's Prison.transport: Players must talk to Haskell () on the western-most dock of Rellekka in order to reach the Island of Stone (). When on the island, players may enter the prison through the entrance at the centre of the island.

Lighthouse Dungeon.title: Lighthouse
Lighthouse Dungeon.transport:
The fastest way getting there is fairy ring code fairy ring ALP. Players can get there from the Barbarian Outpost by jumping across the northern basalt rocks that protrude from the sea. It is possible to slip on the rocks, which results in the player falling into the water, being swept back to shore, and taking up to 10 damage. It is noted that having an Agility level above 35 increases the likelihood of successfully jumping across the rocks. Players seem to have a lot of trouble getting over the rock as the character "fails" to jump over it several times.

Another route of access is via a bridge, which is fixed during the quest. The bridge is located in the south-western part of the Fremennik Province. If the bridge has not been fixed, the player can jump across it and gain 1 Agility experience, but failing to cross the bridge will deal anywhere between 1 and 5 damage and grant 0.7 Agility experience.

Besides the fairy ring, there are three teleports that arrive near the Lighthouse:
• A games necklace or Minigame Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost.
• Teleport to House, if the player's house is at Rellekka.
• An enchanted lyre teleport to the entrance to Rellekka.

Waterbirth Island Dungeon.title: Waterbirth Island Dungeon
Waterbirth Island Dungeon.transport: Waterbirth Dungeon is a large dungeon found on Waterbirth Island and consists of several sublevels that contain powerful, aggressive monsters. Players must be prepared to encounter all three combat styles. Few safespots are available, so those adventurers who wish to explore the dungeon must take caution.

Chasm of Fire.title: Chasm of Fire
Chasm of Fire.transport:
There are several ways to reach the dungeon:
• A chasm teleport scroll brings players inside the dungeon on the bottom floor (only if you've previously been to Great Kourend).
• The Fairy ring code fairy ring DJR will bring the players just south-east of the Chasm (only if you've previously been to Great Kourend).
• Using Kharedst's memoirs to teleport to the Graveyard of Heroes via reminiscing "History and Hearsay". Requires completion of Tale of the Righteous.
• Using Battlefront teleport brings players just north-west of the chasm.
• Using a skills necklace to teleport to the Farming Guild, and then running south-east. A form of antipoison is recommended due to lizardmen on the way.

Entrana Dungeon.title: Entrana Dungeon
Entrana Dungeon.transport:
__NOTOC__
The Entrana Dungeon is found on the north-west corner of Entrana. Entering the dungeon drains your Prayer to almost zero, and there is no way to climb back up to Entrana from inside.

It is visited during the Lost City and Recipe for Disaster quests.

There are zombies, greater demons and during the Lost City quest, a Dramen Tree Spirit. However, armour and weapons can't be brought to the island, so the player must obtain their own via killing the zombies or demons.

Demonic Ruins.title: Demonic Ruins
Demonic Ruins.transport:
• The Annakarl Teleport spell (or its tablet equivalent) can teleport players directly to the ruins. (Needs the completion of Desert Treasure I)
• The level 50 Wilderness Obelisk will also teleport players reasonably close.
Both of these teleports are members-only.

Ogre Enclave.title: Ogre Enclave
Ogre Enclave.transport:
If returning to this cave after completing the Watchtower Quest, you will not need any cave nightshade, as you can just sneak past the Enclave guards without it. Also, you do not need a light source when entering the cave unlike the other Skavid caves nearby. To leave the cave, there is an exit in the centre of the north wall. It will take you to the north cave near the pathway to Gu'Tanoth.
• Teleport to your house in Yanille (requires 50 Construction) and run west, then south to the entrance of Gu'Tanoth. Alternatively, if you have 39 Agility, 38 Strength and 21 Ranged, you can use a Mith grapple on the wall in south-west Yanille to take you right to the entrance of the city. With 69 Agility, this shortcut can be used without a grapple and without Strength or Ranged level requirement.
• Teleport to Castle Wars using a ring of dueling and run south over the bridge and then east to the entrance.
• If you have completed the Watchtower Quest, teleport to the Watchtower using the spell, run east and use the shortcut requiring level 16 Agility to get inside Yanille. Run south and use the grapple shortcut if you are able to.
• Use the Minigame interface to teleport to the Nightmare Zone and then run west through Yanille or over the south-east corner of the city to get to the entrance.
• There are two fairy rings fairly close to the entrance. The one north-west of Yanille fairy ring CIQ and running south, or the one in Feldip Hills fairy ring AKS and running north (beware of Ogres…

Kalphite Lair.title: Kalphite Lair
Kalphite Lair.transport:
• Fairy ring - A quick way to access the lair is using the nearby fairy ring with the code fairy ring BIQ. Then, run north-west towards the lair.
• Shantay Pass - An alternative is entering the desert via Shantay Pass, which is located south of Al Kharid and requires a Shantay pass, and heading westward to the lair.
• Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon - Alternatively, those with access to Dorgesh-Kaan will be able to find a blocked tunnel in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon that leads through to the lair, emerging at the tunnel near some kalphite workers. A light source is necessary to avoid damage from swarming insects.
• Lumbridge Swamp - On the southern coast of the Lumbridge swamp, south-west of the the start point for Misthalin Mystery, a shortcut requiring level 66 Agility takes the player just a few tiles from the entrance. As the player will not need a dramen staff, Shantay pass, or light source to reach the entrance this way, it maximises the number of useful inventory slots for those who haven't completed the Elite Lumbridge Diary.

Kalphite Cave.title: Kalphite Cave
Kalphite Cave.transport:
• Using a desert amulet 4 teleports the player directly there.
• Using an achievement diary cape to teleport to the Shantay Pass.
• Minigame teleport to Sorceress's Garden
• Using an amulet of glory to teleport to Al Kharid, then running south.
• Using fairy ring fairy ring BIQ to teleport to the Kalphite Lair, then run north-east.
• Teleporting to the player's house in Pollnivneach (or using a Pollnivneach teleport) and taking the magic carpet to Shantay Pass.
• Teleport to the Emir's Arena, then run south.
• Using a necklace of passage to teleport to Eagle's Eyrie, running south to the bridge, and then running north-west.

Smoke Devil Dungeon.title: Smoke Devil Dungeon
Smoke Devil Dungeon.transport:
There are several ways to access the dungeon:
• The fairy ring code fairy ring BKP will bring the players just south-west of the dungeon.
• Using a ring of dueling to teleport to Castle Wars, then running south-west.

Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.title: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.transport:
As the dungeon is located within the Wilderness, players must go through the Wilderness to get to the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. Methods of getting to the dungeon include:

• Using the Wilderness Obelisk. The closest obelisk is the level 27 obelisk, located slightly south-east of the entrance. The Wilderness Obelisk system can be quickly accessed from one's player-owned house (80 Construction required), or by teleporting to the Corporeal Beast's cave and running south-east to the level 19 obelisk. Completion of the hard tier of the Wilderness diary allows the player to select the destination obelisk.
• Casting the Cemetery Teleport spell on the Arceuus spellbook or the corresponding tablet to The Forgotten Cemetery and running east.
• Casting the Dareeyak Teleport spell on the Ancient spellbook or breaking a Dareeyak teleport tablet to the ruins at level 23 Wilderness. Both require completion of Desert Treasure I to use.
• Using a burning amulet teleport to the Bandit Camp and running west then north.
• Using the agility shortcut from Trollheim puts you much closer than running directly from Edgeville, but requires 64 Agility.
• Running directly from the Ferox Enclave.
• Running directly to the dungeon from Edgeville.
• Using a Revenant cave teleport and running west.

Crash Site Cavern.title: Crash Site Cavern
Crash Site Cavern.transport:
The entrance to the Crash Site Cavern may be found north-west of the Grand Tree through the opening in the fence. Once through the fence run north-east to enter the cavern.

There are a few ways to get to the Grand Tree from which you can run to the cavern.

• Use the royal seed pod's teleport option which takes you to the base of the Grand Tree. This is the fastest travel option.
• Use a Spirit tree to the Gnome stronghold and run north and then north-west to the gap in the fence.
• Use the Gnome glider to Ta Quir Priw which will take you to the top of the Grand Tree. Descend the tree and run north-west to the gap in the fence.

Edgeville Dungeon.title: Edgeville Dungeon
Edgeville Dungeon.transport:
There are three entrances to the dungeon:
• One is found in Edgeville, in the ruined house south of the bank. It is a trapdoor by a coffin marked by a dungeon icon () on the minimap. ()
• The other is found in a locked shed west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key, which can be found in the dungeon. ()
• An obstacle pipe Agility shortcut from the Varrock Sewers, near Bryophyta's lair. ()
Alternatively, the Paddewwa Teleport on the Ancient Magicks spellbook can be used to teleport directly into the dungeon.

Meiyerditch Laboratories.title: Meiyerditch Laboratories
Meiyerditch Laboratories.transport:
The entrance to the Meiyerditch Laboratory is in the house with the slashed tapestry, which is south-east of the location you arrive at once exiting the Meiyerditch mine.
There are various ways to get there:

• One of the fastest ways to reach the Meiyerditch Laboratories is to ask the closest Vyrewatch to be sent to the mines, and then exiting. Once you exit, follow the path to the house with the slashed tapestry and climb down the stairs to enter the Meiyerditch Laboratories (See image: "Route to the Meiyerditch Laboratories").
• To exit the mine immediately, players who haven't completed The Blood Moon Rises up until the final Lowerniel Drakan fight will need to equip three pieces of Vyre noble clothing when speaking with a Vampyre Juvinate. Otherwise, one must mine 15 daeyalt ore to exit; bring the best pickaxe you can use, or ask the Meiyerditch miners for a spare bronze pickaxe.
• Access to the bloodvelds is only possible after killing the mutated bloodveld that appears during the Sins of the Father quest, as otherwise the door will not open.

• After Sins of the Father, players can also do the following:
• Use a Hallowed crystal shard and exit the Hallowed Sepulchre. Run south and west to reach the cracked wall, follow the path to the house with slashed tapestry, then climb down the stairs.
• Teleport to Edgeville or the Grand Exchange, cross the wilderness ditch and run north to the Mage of Zamorak. Enter the Abyss and go to the blood rift, being sure to select the…

Stronghold Slayer Cave.title: Stronghold Slayer Cave
Stronghold Slayer Cave.transport:
The entrance to the Stronghold Slayer Cave is located in the Gnome Stronghold near Nieve, who is located just south-west of the spirit tree. ()

There are various ways to get there:
• Use a Slayer ring to teleport directly to the entrance by Nieve.
• Use the gnome glider to Ta Quir Priw, which will take you to the Grand Tree. Exit the Grand Tree and run south-west to the entrance.
• Use the spirit tree to the Gnome Stronghold and run south-west.
• Use the necklace of passage to Teleport to 'Outpost' and then run north-east.
• Use the royal seed pod to Teleport to the Grand Tree, then run south-west.
• Use the Achievement diary cape to Teleport to Elder Gnome child, then run south-west.

Forthos Dungeon.title: Forthos Dungeon
Forthos Dungeon.transport:
The dungeon can be easily reached by various teleport methods:
• Xeric's talisman - Teleporting to Xeric's Glade brings players just east of the eastern dungeon entrance.
• Kharedst's memoirs/Book of the Dead - Using the "Lunch by the Lancalliums" teleport brings the player by the River Hos just north-east of the dungeon entrances.
• Watson teleport - Brings the player to Watson's house, just west of the Forthos Ruin.
• Spirit tree - Brings the player just south of the Ruin.
• Lovakengj Minecart Network - The Hosidius West station of the minecart network brings the player just south of the Ruin.
• Skills necklace - Teleport to the Woodcutting Guild and run north.
• Hosidius player-owned house portal - Teleport to House spell or redirected house tab and run north west.

Burgh de Rott.title: Burgh de Rott
Burgh de Rott.transport:
Several teleports bring players into or close to Burgh de Rott, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

• Morytania legs 3 — entrance to the town. Requires Diary hard Morytania diary.
• Mort'ton teleport — Mort'ton town centre, slightly north of Burgh de Rott.
• Barrows Teleport — Barrows, north-east of the town.
• Drakan's medallion — Ver Sinhaza, from which players can run to the Icyene Graveyard and take the boat to town.
• Minigame teleport — Shades of Mort'ton entrance north of the town. Usable once every 20 minutes.
• Fairy ring fairy ring BIP — the island east of the Mage Training Arena. Requires 50 Agility.

Darkmeyer.title: Darkmeyer
Darkmeyer.transport:
• After exiting the Meiyerditch mine, a crack in the wall just north of the Meiyerditch mine exit leads players to the lower tier of the city.
• After completing Sins of the Father, Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the city's upper tier.
• A shortcut (requiring 63 Agility) becomes available on the eastern wall of Darkmeyer, requiring two long ropes, that can be bought for 104,000 coins (52,000 coins each, at full stock) in the Darkmeyer General Store.
• With 52 Agility, 66 Thieving, and completion of Sins of the Father, hallowed crystal shards, bought with hallowed marks from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop (five are given freely at the first visit), teleport the player to the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby in the north-east section of the city.

Haunted Woods.title: Haunted Woods
Haunted Woods.transport:
The Haunted Woods is a large swampy forest in Morytania. It is located east of Canifis and is home to leeches, swamp crabs and feral vampyres, all of which are aggressive. A certain kind of non-attackable spider can also be found in the Haunted Woods that will summon a level 72 feral vampyre if a player gets too close.
There is a fairy ring (code fairy ring ALQ) south of the Port Phasmatys farming patch.

The Haunted Woods is the only place where hollow trees can be found, which can be cut for bark. It also contains a few yew trees to the far east, as well as a large number of non-interactable

Meiyerditch.title: Meiyerditch
Meiyerditch.transport:
The player must begin the Darkness of Hallowvale quest before they may travel to Meiyerditch. The following methods can be used to get there.

• Boarding the boat south of Burgh de Rott, on the eastern dock.
• Taking the rowboat to Slepe north of Port Phasmatys for 10,000 coins and running to Ver Sinhaza.
• After completing A Taste of Hope, the Drakan's medallion, can be used to teleport to Ver Sinhaza in the south-eastern part of Meiyerditch.

Slepe.title: Slepe
Slepe.transport:
The quickest methods of reaching Slepe are as follows:
• Teleporting to Slepe via Drakan's medallion after using a Slepey tablet on it.
• Spider cave teleport and run south-east.
• Hallowed crystal shard to Hallowed Sepulchre exit, then use the shortcut on the eastern wall of Darkmeyer.
• Teleporting to Ver Sinhaza via Drakan's medallion, then running north. Once players pass the small dock, run east to arrive at Slepe.
• Using the ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus, then heading north to the small dock and paying Andras 10,000 coins to row to Slepe. The player will arrive at a dock just south-west of Slepe.
• Teleporting to Darkmeyer via Drakan's medallion, then use the shortcut on the eastern wall of Darkmeyer.
• Teleport to Burgh de Rott with the Morytania legs 3 or 4 or to the Shades of Mort'ton Minigame Teleport after completing the Shades of Mort'ton quest, which has a 20 minute cooldown, then go south to Burgh de Rott. Go to the southern shore and use the boat to go to Meiyerditch. Traverse the wall obstacles, run east along the shore, and then enter Ver Sinhaza. Go north through the opening in the wall to arrive at Slepe.
• After partial completion of Sins of the Father, the boat south of Burgh de Rott goes directly to Slepe and the Icyene Graveyard.

Neypotzli.title: Neypotzli
Neypotzli.transport:
The entrance to Neypotzli is accessed from the northernmost end of Cam Torum, which can be reached in the following ways:
• Teleporting with a calcified moth.
• Taking the Quetzal Transport System to the entrance of Cam Torum, then running all the way north once inside. Requires having built the landing site there.
• Taking the Quetzal Transport System to the Teomat, and then running around the west side of the mountain.
• Players with level 47 Agility may run south-east to the agility shortcut, then crossing the bridge west to the city entrance.

Wyrmscraig.title: Wyrmscraig
Wyrmscraig.transport:
• Sail with your ship and dock at the island, requiring 62 Sailing
• Casting Teleport to Boat (if it's docked at the island, requiring 67 Magic and a greater teleport focus)
• Necklace of passage (after Fallen From Grace)
• Slayer ring (after Fallen From Grace)
• Ardeaglais teleport (after Fallen From Grace, dropped by the Mad Angel)

Wyrmscraig Cavern.title: Wyrmscraig Cavern
Wyrmscraig Cavern.transport:
• A Slayer ring can teleport to the cavern, after completion of Fallen From Grace. This will teleport the player in the junction connecting to the outer cave, cathedral basement, and wyrms.
• Teleport to Boat can be used with a boat docked within the cavern, with a built greater teleport focus boat facility.
• Running to the dungeon entrance from a teleport to the surface of Wyrmscraig:
• Necklace of passage
• Ardeaglais teleport
• Teleport to Boat

Poison Waste Dungeon.title: Poison Waste Dungeon
Poison Waste Dungeon.transport:
Partial completion of The Path of Glouphrie is required to access the dungeon. The dungeon is in a canyon east of the Poison Waste. It is technically in Tirannwn, but you cannot reach it by passing through the main parts of Tirannwn, Arandar and Isafdar. The dungeon can be accessed by taking a spirit tree to the Poison Waste or by using a crossbow and mithril grapple to cross the river. The grapple location can be accessed by the fairy ring fairy ring BKP (partial completion of the Fairytale II - Cure a Queen quest is required), or by walking from Castle Wars.

The entrance to the dungeon is west of the spirit tree, along the edge of the poison waste.

Deepfin Mine.title: Deepfin Mine
Deepfin Mine.transport:
Deepfin Mine is a dungeon containing several mineable rocks including lead rocks and nickel rocks. It is accessible by entering the cave on Deepfin Point, which requires level 67 Sailing to dock at (unboostable).

The dungeon contains two unbuilt bank chest spaces as well as Durrik's Goods, a general store with a unique stock of items for sale. Each bank chest requires 1 magic stone, 2 cupronickel bars, 2 adamantite bars, and 4 ironwood planks to build. The two eastern parts of the mine are linked with an agility shortcut, requiring 84 Agility to use.

There are also attackable aberrant spectr

Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.title: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.transport:
The entrance to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon is east of Rellekka and north-east of Sinclair Mansion (). There are several ways to reach the cave:

• (Fastest method) Players may use the Slayer ring to teleport next to the cave exit.
• Players can get there via the fairy rings (code fairy ring AJR). This is also a fast way to bank in Zanaris.
• Players can set out from Rellekka and head south-east past the Golden Apple Tree.
• The Rellekka home teleport, enchanted lyre, or Fremennik sea boots can be used to quickly reach Rellekka, if the player meets the requirements to use them.
• Players can travel south from the entrance to the underground city of Keldagrim.
• The eagle transport system gets the player a bit to the north of the cave.
• Players may teleport to Camelot and travel the road that leads north, taking a left at the first fork, which leads you towards Rellekka. There is a log balance shortcut south-west of the cave, requiring 48 Agility to pass.

Deep Wilderness Dungeon.title: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
Deep Wilderness Dungeon.transport:
There are several ways to reach the deep wilderness dungeon:
• Casting Ice Plateau Teleport and running East, requiring level 89 Magic and costing 3 law, 3 astral and 8 water runes. The dungeon entrance is approximately 90 tiles from the teleport location. Note that the teleport location features aggressive level 57 ice warriors.
• Using the wilderness lever from Edgeville or Ardougne and running West past the Mage Arena, approximately 150 tiles in total. This route requires a knife or a slash weapon to cut the web at the edge of the Deserted Keep.
• Running from the level 44 wilderness obelisk - first North to the gate on the Western edge of the wilderness fence, and then East to the entrance, is approximately 175 tiles.

The fastest way to leave the wilderness from the deep wilderness dungeon is to run East to the Mage Arena bank, from which players can teleport as normal. This route requires a knife or a slash weapon to cut the web at the bank's entrance.

Giants' Den.title: Giants' Den
Giants' Den.transport:
• Lovakengj Minecart Network to Shayzien West brings you right next to the dungeon
• Kourend Castle Teleport or Xeric's talisman teleport to Xeric's Heart, enter the catacombs of Kourend, run west to the skeletons and climb the vine ladder.
• Fairy ring fairy ring DJR and run south-west, by the coast. Just south of the dock, there is a cave.
• Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead to 'History and Hearsay' Shayzien teleport, run south-west through the graveyard gate, then north-west.

Smoke Dungeon.title: Smoke Dungeon
Smoke Dungeon.transport:
• Teleport to House (if house is in Pollnivneach)
• Scroll of redirection on a Teleport to house (tablet) for a Pollnivneach teleport
• Using a Nardah teleport and then taking a magic carpet to Pollnivneach
• Using a desert amulet 2 or higher and then taking a magic carpet to Pollnivneach
• From Al Kharid, go through the Shantay Pass and take a magic carpet to Pollnivneach
• Teleport to the Jaldraocht Pyramid with the Pharaoh's sceptre, then running north-east.
• Fairy Ring fairy ring DLQ will take you North of Nardah

Waterfall Dungeon.title: Waterfall Dungeon
Waterfall Dungeon.transport:
Note: Players must use a rope to reach the dungeon's entrance unless they have completed the medium Kandarin Diary. Players who have not completed Waterfall Quest must also have Glarial's amulet in their inventory (or be wearing it) to gain entry to the dungeon - it is not needed after the quest.

A quick way of getting to Baxtorian Falls is using a games necklace and travelling to Barbarian Outpost, then running south.

When you have both of these items, go to the house above the Baxtorian Falls. West of it, behind a gate, there is a log raft. Click the raft to ride it and you will crash into a little island.

Do not use the available left-click option to swim to the rock to the south; instead, use your rope on that rock. Once you have safely reached the rock, you are at the top of the Baxtorian Falls. Again, do not fall for the left-click option on the dead tree, but use your rope on that tree to climb down.

You now will be on a small ledge with a barrel and an entrance. If you have completed Waterfall Quest or have Glarial's amulet with you, you may safely enter the dungeon. Otherwise, the barrel allows you to leave the ledge without losing Hitpoints.

If you try to enter without the amulet, or if you forgot to use the rope instead of either of the left-click options, you will fall down the waterfall and wash up to the south, losing 8 Hitpoints. You will then have to run back north onto the top of the waterfall and start over.

Shellbane Gryphon Cave.title: Shellbane Gryphon Cave
Shellbane Gryphon Cave.transport:
The Shellbane Gryphon Cave is a dungeon found on The Great Conch and is home to the Shellbane gryphon boss. The cave entrance is protected by Elder Nama, who prevents players from entering unless they have an appropriate slayer task or an elite clue scroll directing them to kill the shellbane gryphon. Although the cave is a multicombat area, the boss fight takes place in a solo instance.

The entrance to the cave is north of the fairy ring fairy ring CJQ. Players may not place a dwarf multicannon or light a fire within the cave; attempting to do so produces the messages and respectively.

Enchanted Valley.title: Enchanted Valley
Enchanted Valley.transport:
The Enchanted Valley is a hidden realm that is only accessible by fairy ring, using code fairy ring BKQ. When a player first appears in the valley, they will be standing behind a waterfall, and from here, they can follow an incline down into the valley. Scattered throughout the area are trees, rocks, and fishing spots, although they cannot be used for skilling; attempting to gather resources from these spots will spawn the now-discontinued guardians that formerly spawned via random events.

To the west of the waterfall is an inconspicuous bush, where a master STASH unit can be built. This unit

Keldagrim.title: Keldagrim
Keldagrim.transport:
Travelling to Keldagrim requires starting The Giant Dwarf quest. The quest can be started by talking to the dwarven boatman just outside the city, in the cave north-east of Rellekka.

• A common method of getting to Keldagrim is by using the trapdoor located in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to take a minecart to the south-eastern section of the city.
• Additionally, Keldagrim can be travelled to via minecart from the underground White Wolf Mountain passageway or the Dwarven Mine under Ice Mountain for a fee of 100 or 150 coins respectively.
• Players can use fairy ring code fairy ring DKS to teleport right next to the cave entrance to Keldagrim.
• Players can also use an enchanted lyre or Fremennik sea boots, and then walk north-east around the outside of Rellekka to reach the entrance to Keldagrim.
• After completing Another Slice of H.A.M., players can use the Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system.
• Players can also use the Minigame Teleport for either the Blast Furnace or the Rat Pits (requiring Ratcatchers to be completed).
• After completion of the quest Between a Rock..., players can use a ring of wealth to teleport to Dondakan's rock which gets players close to the ferry system that can be used to enter Keldagrim. It should be noted that 2 coins will be needed in order to cross the river to travel via the dwarven boatman.

Death Plateau.title: Death Plateau
Death Plateau.transport: Death Plateau is a short quest wherein you are to help the Burthorpe Imperial Guard gain access to the Death Plateau in order to defeat the hostile trolls.

Troll Stronghold.title: Troll Stronghold
Troll Stronghold.transport: Troll Stronghold is a quest about gaining access to the Troll Stronghold beneath Mount Trollheim in order to rescue Godric, a soldier from Burthorpe. It is the second quest in the Troll Series.

The Forgotten Cemetery.title: The Forgotten Cemetery
The Forgotten Cemetery.transport:
• Use Cemetery Teleport (spell or portal in POH) or the Cemetery teleport tablet, which will teleport you directly to the cemetery.
• Use Dareeyak Teleport or Dareeyak teleport tablet, which will teleport you to ruins, south of the cemetery.
•
• Use burning amulet to teleport to Lava Maze, then run south-west. This WILL take you to level 41 Wilderness.
• If you have access to choose a Wilderness Obelisk, you can select the level 27, teleport, and run west.

Dragon Nest.title: Dragon Nest
Dragon Nest.transport:
The Dragon Nest is a cave east of Tal Teklan in the Tlati Rainforest. Completion of Children of the Sun is required to access the Rainforest, but the Nest has no other requirements to access. It is visited as part of the Scrambled! quest, where the player must retrieve a dragon egg from the south-east corner of the cave. Upon attempting to take the egg, the player is attacked by and must defeat a red dragon.

Dragon Nest contains 5 blue dragons and 5 red dragons, in addition to 2 baby blue dragons and 2 baby red dragons. Item spawns include 4 blue dragon scales, some burnt bones, and a number

Heroes' Guild.title: Heroes' Guild
Heroes' Guild.transport:
• The Portal of Heroes on the floor 2 of the Myths' Guild can be used to teleport outside the front door of the Heroes' Guild.
• The Teleport to House spell (if the player-owned house is in Taverley), or a redirected Taverley teleport tablet.
• A games necklace or Minigame Teleport to the Burthorpe Games Room.
• A combat bracelet can be used to teleport to the Warriors' Guild, north of the Heroes' Guild.

Ruins of Tapoyauik.title: Ruins of Tapoyauik
Ruins of Tapoyauik.transport:
Transport routes to the ruins include:
• The Pendant of Ates can teleport directly to the Twilight Temple, near the lift.
• Quetzal Transport System to Salvager Overlook (requires the Landing site to be built) and run South towards the Twilight Temple.
• Quetzal Transport System to Quetzacalli Gorge (unlocked by default) and run North-East through the gate followed by a turn to the South around The Proudspire mountain.

The lift platform at the Tower of Ascension can then be used as a shortcut after completion of The Heart of Darkness quest, which will bring you to the centre of the slayer area part of the dungeon.

Ungael.title: Ungael
Ungael.transport:
Ungael is an island located in the northernmost region of the Northern Ocean. An abandoned dragonkin fortress and laboratory can be found here. It can be reached by boarding Torfinn's boat directly north of the Rellekka marketplace.

Sometime during the Dragonkin Conflicts, it was used as the base of operations for Zorgoth's experiments, which took place in the laboratory underneath the island. Here, he brought spores and fungi from Lithkren to Ungael to use for his experiments. It is here in which Zorgoth created Vorkath, and left it there in order to guard the route to the laboratory from in

Mos Le'Harmless Cave.title: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
Mos Le'Harmless Cave.transport:
The cave can be reached through a few methods:
• Teleporting to Trouble Brewing using the Trouble Brewing Minigame Teleport or rum and running southwest (or north over the northern stepping stone with 82 Agility Agility).
• Travelling to Mos Le'Harmless' main settlement, running north through the northern entrance, then south-east through the forest. Players with 60 Agility Agility can instead use the stepping stone shortcut on the settlement's east side to cross the estuary.
• The settlement can be reached by using Mos Le'Harmless teleport scrolls, taking a charter ship, speaking to Bill Teach in Port Phasmatys, or speaking to Brother Tranquility on Harmony Island.

Iorwerth Camp.title: Iorwerth Camp
Iorwerth Camp.transport:
The Iorwerth Camp can be reached in several ways, all of which require partial (or full) completion of Regicide. Listed here in order from closest to furthest:

• Iorwerth camp teleport — camp centre.
• Spirit tree — Prifddinas, a short walk north of the village.
• Charter ship — Port Tyras, slightly south of the camp (costs 3200).
• Fairy ring fairy ring BJS — island west of the camp (requires 76 Agility to leave the island).
• Zul-andra teleport — Zul-Andra, south of the camp.
• Teleport crystal — Lletya, east of the poison waste.

From Port Tyras, the camp is reached from the following path: north, east, south, east, north, west, north.

Lletya.title: Lletya
Lletya.transport:
The only way to teleport to Lletya directly is a charged teleport crystal. Players can obtain new crystals as a common drop from the elves in the village. Recharging costs 150 to 750, depending on how many times it's been charged before.

Beyond the teleport crystal, players can reach Lletya on foot after teleporting nearby. Although they all require substantial walking, several methods of teleporting this way exist, listed here from shortest walk to longest:

• Teleport crystal will teleport you directly to Lletya.
• Eternal teleport crystal, a variant of the teleport crystal with unlimited charges (after completing Song of the Elves).
• Iorwerth camp teleport, then navigating the forest (after completing Regicide).
• Spirit tree to Prifddinas, then navigating the forest (after completing Song of the Elves).
• Charter ship to Port Tyras for 3200, then navigating the forest (after completing Regicide).
• Fairy ring fairy ring BJS, then navigating the forest (with 76 Agility and completion of Regicide).
• Necklace of passage to the Outpost, passing Arandar, and navigating the forest.
• West Ardougne Teleport, then traversing the Underground Pass, and finally, navigating the forest.

Mourner Headquarters.title: Mourner Headquarters
Mourner Headquarters.transport:
• West Ardougne Teleport spell or tablet
• Ardougne Teleport spell or tablet
• Spirit tree to the Battlefield of Khazard
• Minigame teleport to the Ardougne Rat Pit
• Slayer ring teleport to the Dark Beasts in the Mourner Tunnels (requires completion of Mourning's End Part II)

Kurask Lair.title: Kurask Lair
Kurask Lair.transport: Kurask Lair is a dungeon beneath Laguna Aurorae, accessed by a cave entrance. It is a small cave that contains eight kurask. A dwarf multicannon can be used in the dungeon, although cannonballs don't damage kurask. The entire dungeon is single-way combat.

Kraken Cove.title: Kraken Cove
Kraken Cove.transport:
There are several ways to access the cove:
• The fairy ring code fairy ring AKQ will bring the players just east of the Cove.
• Using a Piscatoris teleport scroll, or either the Western banner 3 or 4 to teleport the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, and running south-west.

Stalker Den.title: Stalker Den
Stalker Den.transport:
The den has two entrances:

• Southern entrance requiring 59 Agility ()
• Quetzal to Auburnvale, run west then north.
• After activating the Statue of Ates, use the Pendant of Ates to go to Nemus Retreat then run north.
• Fairy ring fairy ring AIS to Auburn Valley, then run north-west.
• Northern entrance ()
• Fairy ring fairy ring BLS to Kebos Lowlands, then run south to the pass, then take the rowboat across the lake, then enter the cave south east.
• Use Xeric's Talisman to Xeric's Honour, descending to South of Quidamortem with the Mountain Guide, then running south.

Sophanem Dungeon.title: Sophanem Dungeon
Sophanem Dungeon.transport: The Sophanem Dungeon is a series of tunnels under Sophanem which are filled with a variety of scabarites. It is a dangerous dungeon, especially on the cavern level, with many monsters over level 100, which all use different attack styles, making it hard to protect-pray from them. Also, the monsters can roam all over the place and they all have high max-hits, which can kill a weak player in a matter of seconds. A light source is required for the full dungeon.

Uzer Mastaba.title: Uzer Mastaba
Uzer Mastaba.transport:
• Use the fairy ring system to teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run east.
• Teleport to Nardah using a Nardah teleport, desert amulet 2, 3 or 4 and run north-east.
• From Shantay Pass, take a magic carpet to the Ruins of Uzer, then run south.
• Teleport to the Ancient Vault using the Ring of shadows and run north.

Brine Rat Cavern.title: Brine Rat Cavern
Brine Rat Cavern.transport:
The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province, and requires a spade to access. This is a remote area and takes some time to walk to. There are some faster means to get here:

• Fairy ring code fairy ring DKS is very close to the cavern's entrance. Use of the fairy rings requires players to complete at least part of the Fairytale II - Cure a Queen quest.
• The Eagle transport system flies to the Rellekka Hunter area, which is north of the dungeon's entrance. Players must have completed the Eagles' Peak quest to use an eagle to fly here.
• The passage to Keldagrim is close to the cavern's entrance. Players must have at least started The Giant Dwarf quest to have access to Keldagrim. Keldagrim is important in that two transport systems go there:
• The mine carts run to Keldagrim from three locations. One is the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain; access to the tunnel requires completion of the Fishing Contest quest. The second location is in the Dwarven Mine under Ice Mountain. The third is a hatch in the north-west part of Grand Exchange. All carts are free of charge.
• A train system runs between Dorgesh-Kaan and Keldagrim. The train is free to use but requires the player to have completed Another Slice of H.A.M. quest.
• The slayer ring teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon is just south of the Brine Rat cavern.
• The use of an enchanted lyre will teleport the player outside the gates of Rellekka, just south of the cavern entrance.

Grimstone Dungeon.title: Grimstone Dungeon
Grimstone Dungeon.transport:
Grimstone Dungeon is a dungeon beneath Grimstone. It contains the Ancient Furnace, which can smelt cannonballs at double the usual speed; an ancient mould; and a fairy ring, code fairy ring DLP. This fairy ring is only accessible once the player has moored on the island at least once.

You can unnote any metal bar(s) here with Isles at a cost of 100 coins per note. Before doing so, however, you need to have sailed to Grimstone and then you must invite him to accompany you there on your boat. He can be found wandering outside the bank at Port Roberts.

Alongside these features, the dungeon is t

Crypt of Tonali.title: Crypt of Tonali
Crypt of Tonali.transport:
• Mokhaiotl waystones can be used to teleport directly inside the Ruins of Mokhaiotl, which is deep beneath the crypt.
• The Pendant of Ates can be used to teleport to Kastori just east of the cavern's entrances.
• The Quetzal Transport System can be used to land at Tal Teklan or Kastori, both near the cavern's entrances.

Ardougne Zoo.title: Ardougne Zoo
Ardougne Zoo.transport:
• Ardougne cloak teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north
• Fairy ring code fairy ring DJP to teleport near the Tower of Life and run north-west
• Code fairy ring BIS can be used to go directly inside the unicorn pen
• Spirit tree to the Khazard Battlefield and run east
• Ardougne teleport and run south-west from the city centre
• Charter a ship to Ardougne (run south-west) or Port Khazard and run (north-west)

Entrana.title: Entrana
Entrana.transport:
Transportation:
• Via a ship in Port Sarim by talking to the monks on the dock
• through the Law Altar via the Abyss in the Wilderness
• Balloon transport system
• Docking there via the Sailing skill (requires 36 Sailing)
• Teleport to Boat — Entrana mooring point once a player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus is docked there.

Before being able to sail or fly to Entrana, the monk or a balloon transport assistant will search the player to make sure that there are no prohibited items being brought to the island. At the law rift, the power of Saradomin is present and will prevent the player from bringing prohibited equipment.

If a player logs in on Entrana or exits the Law Altar with prohibited equipment, a monk will immediately appear next to the player on Entrana and knock them unconscious. The player will then reawaken in Port Sarim aboard the Entrana ferry, and exclaim .

Rules:
Generally, players cannot take any armour with attack or defence bonuses to the island. Most non-equipable items that deal damage (such as runes and poison dynamite) are allowed. Some items which violate these rules can still be brought to the island, listed below.

Trying to Telekinetic Grab dropped items on the coast of Falador will result in a chat message saying . Additionally, players cannot smuggle weapons or armour to Entrana by opening Treasure Trails caskets there, as they cannot be received on the island; an alternate version of the drop table without prohibited items is rolled…

Fremennik Province.title: Fremennik Province
Fremennik Province.transport: The Fremennik Province is a region of various settlements ruled by the Fremennik and barbarians, found north of Kandarin. Besides the mainland, it includes many island settlements, due to the seafaring nature of the Fremennik. The regions features its own Achievement Diary.

Gnome Maze.title: Gnome maze
Gnome Maze.transport:
• Spirit Tree teleport directly to the centre of the maze.
• Fairy ring to (fairy ring CIQ) and run west and then north.
• Ardougne cloak teleport to Ardougne Monastery and run west.
• Inside the city is a house portal, which can be reached with a House Teleport spell or tablet if your player-owned house is located in Yanille.
• A yanille tablet (made from using a scroll of redirection on a house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.
• Minigame teleport to fishing trawler and run west.
• Ardougne Teleport (tablet), run south.

Great Kourend.title: Great Kourend
Great Kourend.transport:
Players can travel to Great Kourend by speaking to Veos by his ship (or Cabin Boy Herbert after A Kingdom Divided) in Port Sarim, directly south of the Rusty Anchor Inn. Doing so will take players to either Port Piscarilius, the easternmost section of the city, or Land's End, the south-western docks near the Kourend Woodland. Players are able to choose to which point they want to be taken. Players can also charter ships to the aforementioned ports from any charter port.

• Players may use the Kharedst's memoirs book (or Book of the Dead after A Kingdom Divided) to teleport here after completing the Client of Kourend quest. This book allows players to teleport to each of the five cities.
• Players with level 25 Construction can have their player-owned house moved to Hosidius north of the Charcoal furnaces for 8,750 coins. Players may also make use of a Hosidius teleport tablet, made by combining a Teleport to house tablet and a Scroll of redirection if they do not wish to move their house. This still requires level 25 Construction.
• Players can unlock the Kourend Castle Teleport spell after completion of Client of Kourend.
• A fairy ring, code fairy ring CIS, will take players north of the Arceuus Library.
• The fairy ring fairy ring DJR teleports players near the Chasm of Fire.
• The fairy ring fairy ring AKR teleports players south of the Vinery.
• The fairy ring fairy ring BLS teleports players south of Mount Quidamortem.
• Players may receive Xeric's talisman from…

Isafdar.title: Isafdar
Isafdar.transport:
Isafdar (Jagex pronunciation: ISS-aff-dar) is the elven forest. It is the largest part of the region Tirannwn, located on the very western edge of the mainland.

Isafdar is located just west of Lletya, and south of Prifddinas. It is reachable by the Underground Pass to the east, by Arandar to the north-east, as well as Port Tyras to the south-west of the forest.

Kebos Lowlands.title: Kebos Lowlands
Kebos Lowlands.transport:
The Kebos Lowlands can be accessed by travelling through Shayziens' Wall in south-west Kourend or walking past the south-west corner of Lovakengj. The area can also be accessed by the following transportation methods:

• Casting Battlefront Teleport (Battlefront)
• Fairy ring (code fairy ring CIR, Mount Karuulm)
• Farming spirit tree (Farming Guild)
• Lovakengj Minecart Network to Mount Quidamortem or the Farming Guild (nearest fairy ring fairy ring CIR)
• Skills necklace (Farming Guild)
• Rada's blessing 3 or Rada's blessing 4 (Mount Karuulm)
• Xeric's talisman (Mount Quidamortem)

Note: There are more transportation options available in the Great Kourend Transportation section, including a transportation map.

Prifddinas.title: Prifddinas
Prifddinas.transport:
All methods of entering the city require completion of Song of the Elves:
• Teleport crystal or eternal teleport crystal to get to the centre of Prifddinas, south of the Tower of Voices
• Breaking a Prifddinas teleport tablet made by using a scroll of redirection on a teleport to house tablet
• Casting Teleport to House or breaking an unredirected teleport to house tablet if your player-owned house is located in Prifddinas
• Construction cape Teleport option, choosing Prifddinas
• Respawn Teleport, ring of returning, ring of life, Defence cape, or death if your spawn point is located in Prifddinas
• Spirit tree close to the northern bank
• Charter ship
• At 70 Sailing, docking at the mooring point west of the city (requires an adamant keel or better to traverse the crystal-flecked waters)
• Iorwerth camp teleport and run south-east through the dense forest
• Necklace of passage to Jorral's outpost and then walk west over the mountain pass of Arandar

Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.title: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.transport:
When walking, go to Port Sarim and head south from the Port Sarim jail, past a grove of willow trees. Go up the small hill and you will arrive at the trapdoor.
For faster transportation, players can use:
• (Fastest method) Giantsoul amulet teleport to Branda and Eldric.
• Fairy ring code fairy ring AIQ, which goes to Mudskipper Point.
• Teleport to House, if the player has a player-owned house located in Rimmington.
• Minigame Teleport to Port Sarim Rat Pits, after completing Rat Catchers.
• An amulet of glory, which can teleport to Draynor Village, the village east of Port Sarim.
• Minigame Teleport to Pest Control, then take the ship to Port Sarim.

Settlement Ruins.title: Settlement Ruins
Settlement Ruins.transport:
• Fairy ring fairy ring CIS and head west up the mountain to the southern entrance.
• Games necklace to the Wintertodt Camp and head south-west down the path to the northern entrance.

The south entrance route via fairy ring is recommended, to avoid spending a games necklace charge and also to avoid the ice wolves.

White Wolf Mountain.title: White Wolf Mountain
White Wolf Mountain.transport:
White Wolf Tunnel:

Once a player has completed the Fishing Contest quest, a tunnel that travels underneath the mountain becomes accessible. This tunnel features a cart station that leads to Keldagrim. The tunnel proves especially useful to low-level players because it avoids the dangerous monsters that live on White Wolf Mountain.

Glider:
A gnome glider manned by Captain Bleemadge is located at the centre peak of the mountain, but it is only accessible to players after they have completed The Grand Tree quest.

Grapple shortcut:
There is a mithril grapple Agility shortcut located at the entrance of the mountain (when coming from Catherby) that requires 35 Strength, 35 Ranged, 32 Agility. This shortcut, however, can only be used when travelling from Catherby to Taverley.

Ice Queen's Lair.title: Ice Queen's Lair
Ice Queen's Lair.transport:
The Ice Queen's Lair is a dungeon located under the White Wolf Mountain. The entrance is blocked by a rock slide requiring a pickaxe and level 50 Mining to remove. The rock slide can not be mined by another player. The lair plays a major role in Heroes' Quest, where players must kill the Ice Queen to obtain ice gloves. Player can get there quickly via the gnome glider.

If a player loses their ice gloves, they may acquire a new pair by slaying the queen again, but because the dungeon is out of the way, it's recommended to get multiple pairs during the quest.

Frozen Waste Plateau.title: Frozen Waste Plateau
Frozen Waste Plateau.transport: The area can be quickly accessed using the Ghorrock Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook (south of the Wilderness fence) at Level 96 Magic, or the Ice Plateau Teleport from the Lunar spellbook (north of the wilderness fence) at Level 89 Magic. Portals to each of these locations can be built in a Portal chamber in a Player-owned house.

Lava Maze.title: Lava Maze
Lava Maze.transport:
Using a burning amulet's Lava Maze teleport is the fastest method, and will teleport you directly to the maze's entrance on the west side. The Ghorrock Teleport and level 44 Wilderness Obelisk also provide quick access to the west side of the maze.

The level 35 Wilderness Obelisk, the Wilderness canoe stop, and the Revenant cave teleport scroll all take the player near the south-east side of the lava maze, and can be good ways to access the Agility shortcut on the north side.

Crandor.title: Crandor
Crandor.transport:
Crandor is first accessed by boat during the Dragon Slayer I quest. Players must obtain all three map pieces and repair the boat; after this, Ned will bring them to the island. After the quest, Crandor can only be accessed via a secret door in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.

To reach the Crandor surface, players must first enter the Karamja Volcano, either by exiting the TzHaar City, or by climbing down from Karamja. The wall can be found in the north-west corner of the area. After passing the wall, players can run north, to the rope they placed during Dragon Slayer I, and climb up the rope to reach the surface.

Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.title: Crandor and Karamja Dungeon
Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.transport:
The Karamja entrance to the dungeon can be accessed by travelling to Musa Point or Brimhaven via ship, then walking west or east, respectively, to the Karamja Volcano. The eastern lip of the volcano has rocks that can be climbed down.

The dungeon can also be accessed by using the Minigame Teleport to TzHaar Fight Pit, travelling east through Mor Ul Rek, then exiting via the cave to the north.

The Crandor side of the dungeon must first be unlocked during Dragon Slayer I. After that, it can be accessed by passing the hidden door at the north end of the Karamja side of the dungeon. The door becomes usable after crash-landing on Crandor.

Sisterhood Sanctuary.title: Sisterhood Sanctuary
Sisterhood Sanctuary.transport:
The quickest methods of reaching Slepe, where the Sisterhood Sanctuary is found, are:
• Using the "Slepe" option on Drakan's medallion, which brings players directly to the Sisterhood Sanctuary. This requires having used a Slepey tablet on the medallion.
• Using the "Ver Sinhaza" option on Drakan's medallion, then running north. Once players pass the small dock, run east to arrive at Slepe.
• Using the Ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus, then heading north to the small dock and paying Andras 10,000 coins to row to Slepe (or for free after paying him a one-off fee of 1,000,000 coins). The player will arrive at a dock just south-west of Slepe.
• Using the Morytania Legs teleport to Burgh de Rott, then take the southern boat to Slepe (after Sins of the Father).

Taverley dungeon.title: Taverley Dungeon
Taverley dungeon.transport:
The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. Ways of getting there include:

• Teleport to House if your house is in Taverley, or Taverley teleport tablet.
• Falador Teleport spell or tablet.
• Balloon transport system to Taverley.
• The south portal in the Wizards' Guild (requires 66 Magic) of Yanille brings the player to the Dark Wizards' Tower located just south.
• Skills necklace teleport to Crafting Guild, then run north.
• Burthorpe Games Room Minigame Teleport or games necklace to Burthorpe, then run south.
• Portal to the Heroes' Guild in the Myths' Guild, then run south.

Temple of Ikov.title: Temple of Ikov
Temple of Ikov.transport: Temple of Ikov is a quest featuring Lucien, a Mahjarrat. The quest revolves around the infiltration of the Temple of Ikov in order to steal a powerful artefact known as the Staff of Armadyl.

Viyeldi caves.title: Viyeldi caves
Viyeldi caves.transport:
The caves are accessed using a winch at the end of the Shaman Caves, which in turn are accessed via a mossy rock in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle.

With 91 Agility, a shortcut down the cliff-face in the final room of the Shaman Caves is available. One long rope must first be used on the rocks next to the blue hat after completion of Legends' Quest.

With 96 Agility, a crevice may be squeezed through directly from the Shaman Caves entrance.

To navigate the caves after the quest (below 96 Agility), bring the following items:

To traverse the caves, the following steps must be taken:

• Enter the caves by searching the Rocks in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle.
• With 96 Agility, use the shortcut on the western wall near the entrance of the cave. Skip to step 9.
• Search the eastern bookcase.
• Use a lockpick (note: a strange old lockpick will not work) on the Ancient Gate (click out of the dialogue if it states your lockpick breaks and try again).
• Smash the three boulders. (Level 52 Mining required to smash boulders).
• Open the next Ancient Gate. (Level 50 Strength required to attempt to move the metal doors).
• Jump-over the jagged wall.
• 'Use' the Marked wall on the west side of the room.
• Manually cast any Charge Orb spell on the northern Ancient Gate.
• Search, then Climb-down the winch.
• Climb-over several rocky ledges.
• With 91 Agility, use the long rope shortcut instead.

Hosidius.title: Hosidius
Hosidius.transport:
• Teleport to House or a redirected teleport to house tablet.
• Xeric's talisman - Xeric's Glade Teleport, north-east of farming patch.
• Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - Lunch by the Lancalliums teleport (requires completion of The Depths of Despair).
• Kourend Castle Teleport - Run east past Kingstown then south after the bridge.
• Spirit tree planted in a spirit tree patch south-east of the Forthos Ruin.
• Skills necklace - North-east of the Woodcutting Guild teleport.
• Tithe Farm minigame teleport - Requires having entered the minigame at least once.
• Travel south of the Rusty Anchor Inn (and north of the Monks of Entrana) in Port Sarim and find Veos on the dock. Then right-click "Port Piscarilius Veos" (don't right-click "Land's End Veos"), run west on the dock of Port Piscarilius, keep running west until you get to a pub, then turn left and run south from Port Piscarilius to Hosidius.
• Fairy ring - fairy ring AKR to Hosidius Vinery, then run north-west.
• Sail and dock there with 5 Sailing, then run north.
• Teleport to Boat — Hosidius mooring point once player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus installed is docked there (requires 75 Sailing), then run north.

Lovakengj.title: Lovakengj
Lovakengj.transport:
• Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Inferno teleport (by the lovakite furnace south of the blast mine)
• Fairy ring fairy ring CIS and run West
• Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - Jewellery of Jubilation teleport (requires completion of The Forsaken Tower)
• Games necklace - Wintertodt teleport and run south-west
• Fairy ring - fairy ring DJR and run north
• Lovakengj Minecart Network

Morytania Spider Cave.title: Morytania Spider Cave
Morytania Spider Cave.transport:
The quickest methods of reaching the cave entrance are as follows:
• Teleporting directly to the cave via use of a spider cave teleport
• Teleporting to Hallowed Sepulchre using a hallowed crystal shard, then exiting and using the wall shortcut just south east. Requires 63 Agility and installing 2 long ropes.
• Teleporting via ectophial or fairy ring code fairy ring ALQ, then running south past the small bridge. Ectophial can be used for convenient banking at Port Phasmatys as well.

Port Piscarilius.title: Port Piscarilius
Port Piscarilius.transport:
There are several methods to quickly reach Port Piscarilius:
• Veos or Cabin Boy Herbert - ship from Port Sarim or Land's End, then run west and north.
• Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - The Fisher's Flute teleport (requires completion of The Queen of Thieves).
• Lovakengj Minecart Network - Travel to the Port Piscarilius station (20 coins per ride, or completion of The Forsaken Tower).
• Kourend Castle Teleport or Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart - Run east past Kingstown, then north along the coast.
• The fairy ring code fairy ring AKR to Hosidius near the Tithe Farm minigame, then run north. A faster alternative is to run south instead and take the Lovakengj Minecart Network cart to Port Piscarillius for 20 coins, located just south of Tithe Farm.
• Tithe Farm Minigame Teleport, then run north. Must have entered the minigame at least once before, which requires Lvl 34 Farming.

Underground Pass.title: Underground Pass
Underground Pass.transport: Underground Pass is the third quest in the Elf quest series, and explores an extensive and perilous dungeon to the west of Ardougne. You must venture through the pass at the request of King Lathas, in order to help him destroy his corrupted brother Tyras.

Al Kharid Mine.title: Al Kharid mine
Al Kharid Mine.transport:
The Al Kharid mine (also called Scorpion mine or Al Kharid Mining pit) is a Mining area located just north of the desert city of Al Kharid.

The mine is advantageous because it is near a bank and a furnace and is located in a very low-risk location for its high-value infrequent rocks, such as gold, mithril, and adamantite. In addition, this mine is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for power-mining.

Dwarven Mine.title: Dwarven Mine
Dwarven Mine.transport:
• South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required. Using a skills necklace to teleport directly to the Mining Guild is the quickest way to get here.
• Alternatively, Lassar Teleport to the top of the Ice Mountain, then run south down to the main entrance.
• Falador entrance: A building in the far north-east of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
• Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador-to-Barbarian Village road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance. Another option is to use the Skull sceptre/Skull sceptre (i) to teleport to Barbarian village and walk north-west towards Ice Mountain.
• Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim mine cart system, to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the Fishing Contest quest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain.

Scorpion Pit.title: Scorpion Pit
Scorpion Pit.transport:
• Pull the lever in either Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north and slash the web, then run east.
• Use a Wilderness Obelisk to travel to level 50 Wilderness. Run west past the Rogues' Castle and the Chaos Elemental.

Ape Atoll Dungeon.title: Ape Atoll Dungeon
Ape Atoll Dungeon.transport:
Access to the island Ape Atoll is obtained through the quest Monkey Madness I.

You can go to the dungeon on Ape Atoll by going to the floor 1 of the Grand Tree and speaking to Daero on the east side. He will then take you to a bunker where you can speak to Waydar who will take you to Crash Island, from which you can speak to Lumdo to visit Ape Atoll near the dungeon.

After completion of Monkey Madness I, there is a teleport spell in the Arceuus spellbook, requiring level 90 Magic to cast, as well as the equivalent magic tablet, which takes players to the tunnels of Ape Atoll Dungeon.

Barrows.title: Barrows
Barrows.transport:
(tab) is the quickest route.

2. (Blue, Green and Orange) Using the Mort'ton minigame teleport, Mort'ton teleport scroll and Morytania legs 3 & 4 are good alternatives to players who don't have access to the Barrows teleport.

3. (Pink and Light blue) Travelling using the Swamp Boaty is a valid method for ironmen who don't have access to abovementioned options.

4. (Yellow) Using the fairy ring BIP fairy ring is the longest of the routes, but takes the player close to the Nature Grotto, which players can visit to restore their prayer points.]]

There are several different methods for travelling to the Barrows. The best options, ordered from fast to slow, are:

• Casting Barrows Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook (requires level 83 Magic), or using a Barrows teleport tablet or house portal to teleport right next to the entrance.
• Using the Mort'ton teleport scroll and then running east to Barrows.
• Using the Morytania legs 3 or 4 to Burgh de Rott and running north through Mort'ton towards Barrows.
• Using the Minigame Teleport to Shades of Mort'ton (requires completion of the Shades of Mort'ton quest). This method is free and takes up no inventory or equipment spaces, though there is a 20-minute cooldown between uses.
• Casting Kharyrll Teleport in the Ancient spellbook (requires level 66 Magic and completion of Desert Treasure I), or using a Kharyrll teleport tablet or house portal to teleport to Canifis, then using the Myreque Hideout shortcut south of the pub and running…

Digsite Dungeon.title: Digsite Dungeon
Digsite Dungeon.transport:
The entrances to the dungeon are at the Digsite. Players can walk to the Digsite from Varrock. There are also two fast ways to get there:
• The Digsite pendant teleports to the north of the Digsite. (Players must play the Varrock Museum miniquest to learn how to enchant ruby necklaces into Digsite pendants.)
• The Gnome glider to Lemanto Andra crashes to the west of the Digsite. Since the glider crashes on arrival, it cannot be used to travel away from the Digsite. (Players can use this glider after completing The Grand Tree quest.)

There are two entrances, each of which goes to a separate part of the dungeon. The entrances are winches that the player must use. The player must use a rope on the west winch to enter the dungeon there, which will not be consumed. The player can use the north-east winch without a rope.

Draynor Manor.title: Draynor Manor
Draynor Manor.transport:
A few teleports bring the player close to the manor:
• Draynor Manor Teleport — directly to the manor doors via the Arceuus spellbook. Players can also use the magic tablet equivalent.
• Amulet of glory — to Draynor Village then walk north to the manor
• Chronicle — to the Champions' Guild then run west to the manor via the stepping stones (31 Agility).

Draynor Sewers.title: Draynor Sewers
Draynor Sewers.transport:
The dungeon is located underneath a trapdoor north-west of Draynor (or north of the marketplace), and through an entrance west of the jailhouse.
• Amulet of glory teleport to Draynor Village

Jiggig.title: Jiggig
Jiggig.transport:
• Ring of dueling teleport to Castle Wars then run south to Jiggig.
• Using Fairy ring code fairy ring BKP and running east.

Jiggig Dungeon.title: Jiggig Dungeon
Jiggig Dungeon.transport:
• Ring of dueling teleport to Castle Wars then run south to Jiggig.
• Using Fairy ring code fairy ring BKP and running east.

Melzar's Maze.title: Melzar's Maze
Melzar's Maze.transport:
Melzar's Maze is a large, three-story building with a basement located north-west of Rimmington. It is the home of Melzar the Mad and contains Melzar's map part required for the Dragon Slayer I quest. To enter the building, players must obtain the Maze key from the Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild during the quest. The building was built by Melzar atop the remains of the Crandorian refugee camp that was destroyed by Elvarg.

Once inside the building, players must go through mazes on each floor and in the basement. However, to proceed to the next floor, players must kill the creature that is

Shayzien Crypts.title: Shayzien Crypts
Shayzien Crypts.transport:
The Shayzien Crypts are an ancient dungeon located in the south-western part of the Graveyard of Heroes, in Shayzien. Players must bring a light source with them or risk getting swarmed over with tiny insects. The crypts are visited during Dragon Slayer II.

Players should use caution when traversing the crypts as they are a multicombat area filled with high-level monsters. A dwarf multicannon may be used in the crypts.

The crypts were constructed long before the founding of Great Kourend 1,510 years ago, and is the burial grounds for the kings and queens of Great Kourend, until a few hundred

Stronghold of Security.title: Stronghold of Security
Stronghold of Security.transport:
The Stronghold of Security is a dungeon, found at the heart of the Barbarian Village mine, west of Varrock.

The dungeon contains four maze-like floors, filled with monsters of increasing level with each descent. The dungeon exists as a way to help players understand how to better protect their account from would-be scammers. This is done by having each room, on every floor, separated by two sets of doors, with the second occasionally asking new visitors security questions. To pass through, they must be answered correctly. In return for a player's efforts, they may choose to receive a few rewa

Tarn's Lair.title: Tarn's Lair
Tarn's Lair.transport:
The lair is found inside the Abandoned Mine and requires a Salve amulet to enter.

• The fastest way to get to Tarn is to teleport to Tarn's Lair via a Slayer ring. This will bring you directly outside of the room with Tarn.
• The fastest way to get to the entrance through the Abandoned Mine is using the Morytania legs 3 to teleport to Burgh de Rott and hop over the Agility shortcut west of the town.

• Using the Minigame Teleport to Shades of Mort'ton or the Mort'ton teleport scroll will place you directly in Mort'ton, which is north-east of the Abandoned Mine.
• By fairy ring fairy ring BIP (50 Agility needed) and then walking south.

To enter Tarn's Lair, climb over the mine cart just south of the Zealot (featured in the Haunted Mine quest), go through the entrance of the Abandoned Mine, and then head north of the entrance.

Varrock Sewers.title: Varrock Sewers
Varrock Sewers.transport:
The Varrock Sewers can be accessed via a manhole just east of Varrock Palace. Members can also access the sewers through Edgeville Dungeon by using a pipe shortcut near Vannaka - this requires 51 Agility, and drops players off near some of the moss giants.

A giantsoul amulet can be used to teleport directly into the sewers, in front of Bryophyta's lair.

Wilderness.title: Wilderness
Wilderness.transport:
The Wilderness, also known as the Wild or Wildy, is a large and dangerous wasteland that makes up most of north-eastern Gielinor.

' The entirety of the Wilderness is a PvP area, except for Ferox Enclave, Mage Arena bank, Corporeal Beast's Lair, and King Black Dragon Lair. When the player is killed by another player, all unprotected items will be lost to the killer. Hardcore ironmen will lose their status if they die to a player, just like they would in the event of any other unsafe death.

Two players or multiple players (within multi-combat zones) may fight if their combat levels are within

Wizards' Tower.title: Wizards' Tower
Wizards' Tower.transport:
• The fairy ring code fairy ring DIS teleports you immediately south of the tower.
• The necklace of passage teleports you to the bridge just north of the tower.
• The Amulet of the Eye teleports the player to the Temple of the Eye, near a portal that takes them to the basement of the guild.
• A ring of the elements can provide a teleport near to the Water Altar entrance, east of the tower.
• An Achievement diary cape can teleport the player to Twiggy O'Korn north of the tower
• An amulet of glory teleport to Draynor Village to the north of the tower.
• Players with 66 Magic can enter the east portal on the floor 2 of the Wizards' Guild.

Isle of Souls.title: Isle of Souls
Isle of Souls.transport:
The isle can be accessed through a few different means:

• Entering the Soul Wars Portal near the Edgeville ruins.
• Entering the Soul Wars Portal inside the Ferox Enclave Dungeon.
• Using the Soul Wars Minigame Teleport.
• Using the fairy ring code fairy ring BJP to reach the northern coast.
• By mooring on the south-east coast with 55 Sailing.
• Using the rowboat from the Tear of the Soul on the south-east coast.

Kourend Woodland.title: Kourend Woodland
Kourend Woodland.transport:
• The Rada's blessing teleport is the quickest way to get here.
• Take the Lovakengj Minecart Network to Kourend Woodland.
• Use the Xeric's Lookout option on the Xeric's talisman, and run south-west.
• Use the Woodcutting Guild option on the Skills necklace, and run south-west.
• Take the boat from Veos to Land's End.

Laguna Aurorae.title: Laguna Aurorae
Laguna Aurorae.transport:
• Mooring point (requires 58 Sailing)
• The mooring point is surrounded by aggressive pygmy krakens, so it's safest to approach the mooring point fast and dock quickly.
• The nearest port with a shipwright to retrieve a boat and sail over is located on Aldarin.
• Spirit tree (requires having moored at the island, but does not require talking to the tree first)

Pirates' Cove.title: Pirates' Cove
Pirates' Cove.transport:
The Pirates' Cove can be accessed only by boat. Players may reach the island either by speaking to Lokar Searunner in Rellekka, provided they have completed the The Fremennik Trials quest (must start Lunar Diplomacy in order for Lokar Searunner to speak to you), or by talking to Captain Bentley on Lunar Isle, provided they have reached a certain point in Lunar Diplomacy. There is no fee either way. With 76 Sailing, a rowboat may be built at the Buccaneers' Haven to access this island, though it requires partial completion of Lunar Diplomacy to use.

There are no teleportation methods through which a player can immediately reach the island; however, players may reach the Lady Zay's port of call on Lunar Isle more quickly by using the Lunar Home Teleport or the Moonclan Teleport found in the Lunar spellbook, which is a reward for the Lunar Diplomacy quest. Players can also access Rellekka more quickly through a variety of means, including the enchanted lyre or teleport to house spell (provided their player-owned house is in Rellekka).

, a pirate vessel known to dock at the cove.]]

Giant Pit.title: Giant Pit
Giant Pit.transport:
The Giant Pit is a small enclosure found north-west of Shayzien. Occupied by 13 Hill Giants, the pit is guarded by three soldiers and their sergeant. A jetty can be found just west where players can board the boaty to Molch, Lake Molch, or the Battlefront.

Just south-west of the pit is a cave entrance that leads to the Giants' Den, which is inhabited by more dangerous giants that have been corrupted by the power of the Dark Altar. Immediately south of the den is the Secluded Chapel.

An easy way to travel to the Giant Pit is to use fairy ring fairy ring DJR and run south; or travel to History

Bone Yard Hunter area.title: Bone Yard Hunter area
Bone Yard Hunter area.transport:
• Burning amulet teleport to the Chaos Temple and run north-east from there.
• Teleport to the level 19 Wilderness Obelisk.
• Carrallanger Teleport (tablet) and run east from there.
• Games necklace teleport to the Corporeal Beast lair and run east.
• Enter the Wilderness from Varrock and run north-east.

Giants' Plateau.title: Giants' Plateau
Giants' Plateau.transport:
• Minigame Teleport to Giants' Foundry
• Necklace of passage to teleport to Eagle's Eyrie, then climb rocks to the west (requires level 54 Agility)
• Amulet of glory to teleport to Al Kharid, then run east through the gate.
• Ring of dueling to teleport to the Emir's Arena, then run south-east.

Warriors' Guild.title: Warriors' Guild
Warriors' Guild.transport:
The Warriors' Guild can be easily accessed in a number of ways;
• Combat bracelet or Strength cape to teleport directly to the Warriors' Guild.
• Games necklace to teleport to Burthorpe, then head west.
• Minigame Teleport to the Burthorpe Games Room, then head west.
• House teleport (if a player's house is in Taverley) or a Taverley teleport tablet, then head north.
• Balloon transport system to Taverley (requires partial completion of Enlightened Journey), then head north-west.

Avium Savannah.title: Avium Savannah
Avium Savannah.transport:
The player must first travel to Civitas illa Fortis via Regulus Cento after completing Children of the Sun before other transportation methods become usable.
• The fairy ring fairy ring AJP is located in the centre of the savannah.
• The Quetzal Transport System, unlocked during Twilight's Promise, has several landing zones in the savannah: one by the entrance to the Hunter Guild, one in Outer Fortis, and one by the Colossal Wyrm Remains. The latter two require a landing site to be built.
• The Hunter cape or max cape teleports players inside the Hunter Guild. Speak to Guildmaster Apatura with either cape equipped or in your inventory and she will unlock the teleport, after a brief conversation.
• A quetzal whistle takes players to the Hunter Guild's landing site. Quetzal whistles can be unlocked after completing 10 Hunters' Rumours.
• Civitas illa Fortis Teleport can be used after Twilight's Promise, and is near a quetzal landing site.

Pirates' Hideout.title: Pirates' Hideout
Pirates' Hideout.transport:
• Pull the lever in either Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep. Run north and slash the web, then run west.
• Ice Plateau Teleport or Ghorrock Teleport to the Frozen Waste Plateau, and then run east.
