Chaos Temple.title: Chaos Temple
Chaos Temple.transport:
Chaos Temple may refer to:

• Chaos Temple (Wilderness), in circa level 12 Wilderness.
• Chaos Temple (Asgarnia), north of Falador, north-west of Goblin Village.
• Chaos Temple (church), prayer training temple in level 38 Wilderness, west of the Lava Maze.
• Zamorakian chapel, the chaos temple in Varrock.
• Chaos Altar, the runecrafting altar.
• Chaos altar (Prayer), prayer altars devoted to Zamorak

Ardougne Sewers.title: Ardougne Sewers
Ardougne Sewers.transport:
• Manhole west of the Estate agent
• Ladder in Jimmy Dazzler's house, which leads to the Rat Pits

Braindeath Island.title: Braindeath Island
Braindeath Island.transport:
Players should go to the dock north-east of Port Phasmatys and the Ectofuntus and talk to Pirate Pete there. He will transport players to the island using his unique bottle teleport method.

The quickest way to get to the dock is to use the Ectophial to teleport to the Ectofuntus. The ectophial is obtained during the Ghosts Ahoy quest.

Another way to get to Pirate Pete is by chartering a ship to Port Phasmatys and running to the north through the energy barrier to Pirate Pete.

Edgeville Dungeon mine.title: Edgeville Dungeon mine
Edgeville Dungeon mine.transport:
• The long way: From the dungeon entrance at Edgeville, through the dungeon.
• The short way: In a small room north of the hill giants but south of the mine, there is the brass key spawn. This key can be used to enter and exit the Edgeville Dungeon via the ladder just north of the hill giants. This is by far the fastest walking route to and from the mine.
• Nearest bank: Varrock west bank, with the brass key. However, if a player has Varrock armour 3, from completing their hard Varrock Diary, they can use the bank within the Cooks' Guild. This bank is closer than Varrock west bank.
• Teleportation: Paddewwa Teleport, from the Ancient Magicks spellbook, teleports the user to the entrance of Edgeville Dungeon. However, this is not recommended for long-term mining due to the distance to the mine from the teleport.

Glarial's Tomb.title: Glarial's Tomb
Glarial's Tomb.transport:
Glarial's Tomb is a dungeon underneath the tombstone near the Baxtorian Falls and the Kingdom of Kandarin. To enter, the player needs Glarial's pebble, which is obtained during the Waterfall Quest, and must not have any weapons, armour or runes either equipped or in their inventory. Level 84 moss guardians roam here.

The location is close to the Fishing Guild; use Glarial's pebble on her tombstone and you may enter. Players can get Glarial's amulet in the west chest. This location can be re-entered after the Waterfall Quest has been completed in order to obtain Glarial's amulet once again.

G

Graveyard of Shadows.title: Graveyard of Shadows
Graveyard of Shadows.transport:
• Carrallanger Teleport, part of Ancient Magicks, goes directly to the graveyard.
• Run north from Ferox Enclave.

Harmony Island.title: Harmony Island
Harmony Island.transport:
The Harmony Island teleport is the only way to direct travel to Harmony Island, landing near the beached ship. All other methods of reaching Harmony Island ultimately require speaking to Brother Tranquility. After starting The Great Brain Robbery, he stands directly north of the Mos Le'Harmless docks and provides transport to the island.

Several transport options bring players into or close to Brother Tranquility, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

• Charter ships — Mos Le’Harmless docks.
• Mos le'harmless teleport — south of the Mos Le'Harmless bank.
• Blue andred rum — Trouble Brewing on the east side of Mos Le’Harmless.
• Minigame teleport — same as rum, but is only usable once every 20 minutes.
• Speaking to Bill Teach on the east side of the Port Phasmatys docks. Teleports near Bill, and their destinations:
• Ectophial — Ectofuntus just north of Port Phasmatys.
• Morytania legs 3 — Ectofuntus slime pit.
• Fairy ring fairy ring ALQ — Haunted Woods west of Port Phasmatys.

Ruins.title: Ruins
Ruins.transport:
There are several places marked Ruins. Their design seems to follow destroyed buildings suggesting a permanent settlement once existed in both areas.

• Ruins (west)
• Ruins (east)
• Demonic Ruins
• Many other, unnamed ruins can also be found around the Wilderness, including south of the Bone Yard, east of the Chaos Temple and south of the Demonic Ruins.
• Settlement Ruins near Wintertodt Camp
• Ruins of Camdozaal
• Ruins of Flamtaer
• Ruins of Isolation
• Ruins of Mokhaiotl
• Ruins of Morra
• Ruins of Tapoyauik
• Ruins of Ullek
• Ruins of Ullek mine
• Ruins of Unkah
• Ruins of Unkah mine
• Ru

Temple of Ah Za Rhoon.title: Ah Za Rhoon
Temple of Ah Za Rhoon.transport:
To get to the temple from Tai Bwo Wannai, go east to the river, cross the log near the crashed glider, and go south along the river until you reach a mound of earth.

Use your spade on it to find a fissure. If you haven't done so already, use a lit light source on the fissure to light up the temple below. (Warning: don't use an expensive light source as you will lose it. Therefore, it is recommended to use a candle or torch). Next, add a rope to the fissure, securing it to the lip. Search the fissure again to climb down into the dungeon below (32 Agility required). After a short period of time the fissure will be covered in earth again - use your spade to uncover the fissure, and the rope and torch will still be in place.

Temple of Marimbo Dungeon.title: Temple of Marimbo Dungeon
Temple of Marimbo Dungeon.transport:
The Temple of Marimbo Dungeon is found under the Temple of Marimbo, on Ape Atoll. It can be entered through the trapdoor found at the east end on the floor 0 of the temple.

The dungeon is composed of three distinct parts. The first area is visited during Monkey Madness I, in which the player makes m'speak amulets with one of the two wall of flames. This area contains some Monkey Zombies and spiders. Large monkey zombies are found on the upper area, spiders are found in the lower area, and small monkey zombies are found all over the cave.

A small crevice in the middle of the first area leads

Tomb of Rashiliyia.title: Rashiliyia's Tomb
Tomb of Rashiliyia.transport:
To get to the tomb, go north beyond the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. There will be stone doors in the ground to enter, provided a bone key is used on them. It may be re-bought after the quest from Yanni Salika.
• Take the fairy ring code fairy ring DKP and run south

Tree Gnome Village dungeon.title: Tree Gnome Village Dungeon
Tree Gnome Village dungeon.transport:
The Tree Gnome Village Dungeon is found beneath the Tree Gnome Village. Its surface entrance is in the maze just south of the main village area.

The dungeon features in Waterfall Quest, where players visit it to obtain glarial's pebble from Golrie. To reach Golrie, a key must first be obtained from the eastern room, which is inhabited by zombies and giant bats. The key is found in the large crate in the south-east corner that is coloured differently from the rest of the crates. The key can then be used in the western room full of hobgoblins to unlock the door Golrie is imprisoned behind.

Aft

Mort'ton.title: Mort'ton
Mort'ton.transport:
Several teleports bring players into or close to Mort'ton, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

• Mort'ton teleport — centre of the town.
• Minigame Teleport — Shades of Mort'ton. Usable once every 20 minutes.
• Barrows teleport — Barrows entrance.
• Morytania legs 3 — Burgh de Rott, south of the town.
• Fairy ring fairy ring BIP — the island west of the Nature Grotto. Requires 50 Agility.
• Fairy ring fairy ring BKR — near the swamp boaty, a small boat that Cyreg will let players ride to the Hollows for 10.

Shade Catacombs.title: Shade Catacombs
Shade Catacombs.transport:
The Shade Catacombs are a complex labyrinth found under Mort'ton as part of the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. The entrance is directly north of the general store and west of the temple, marked as a brown area on the map. To access it you need to have completed Shades of Mort'ton and have a bronze shade key or better.

To get a bronze shade key, you must kill a Loar Shade in Mort'ton, sanctify some olive oil at the repaired temple to make sacred oil, then use the sacred oil on any log, making a pyre log. Use the pyre log on one of the four pyre slabs in one of the seven shade burning areas of Mo

Fremennik Slayer Cave.title: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
Fremennik Slayer Cave.transport:
The entrance to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon is east of Rellekka and north-east of Sinclair Mansion (). There are several ways to reach the cave:

• (Fastest method) Players may use the Slayer ring to teleport next to the cave exit.
• Players can get there via the fairy rings (code fairy ring AJR). This is also a fast way to bank in Zanaris.
• Players can set out from Rellekka and head south-east past the Golden Apple Tree.
• The Rellekka home teleport, enchanted lyre, or Fremennik sea boots can be used to quickly reach Rellekka, if the player meets the requirements to use them.
• Players can travel south from the entrance to the underground city of Keldagrim.
• The eagle transport system gets the player a bit to the north of the cave.
• Players may teleport to Camelot and travel the road that leads north, taking a left at the first fork, which leads you towards Rellekka. There is a log balance shortcut south-west of the cave, requiring 48 Agility to pass.

Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon.title: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon.transport:
The Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon is a dungeon south of the underground city of Dorgesh-Kaan (notated by an Agility icon on the map). Entry to the dungeon requires completion of the Death to the Dorgeshuun quest. The dungeon is dark and requires the player to have a light source or face relentless damage from stinging insects. A tinderbox is recommended (to relight the light source, just in case) but is not necessary. An antipoison potion may also be helpful, as there are several poisonous creatures in the dungeon.

You can use a dwarf multicannon in the dungeon, however it is not multicombat.

Chaos Druid Tower Dungeon.title: Chaos Druid Tower
Chaos Druid Tower Dungeon.transport:
• Teleport to Ardougne with the Achievement diary cape
• Teleport to the Fishing Guild using a skills necklace or Fishing Guild Teleport (Level 85 Magic and Lunar Diplomacy) and run south-west.
• Teleport to the Outpost using a necklace of passage and run east.
• Teleport to the Ardougne farm patch using Ardougne cloak and run west.
• Teleport to Ardougne using the Ardougne Teleport spell or tablet and run north-west to the Chaos Druid Tower, then go to its basement.
• Teleport to West Ardougne using West Ardougne Teleport spell or tab and running east through the gate into East Ardougne and then north.

Clock Tower Dungeon.title: Clock Tower dungeon
Clock Tower Dungeon.transport: The Clock Tower dungeon is a major part of the Clock Tower quest. It is a huge, multi-zone dungeon complex underneath the south-western part of East Ardougne. It is where you find the four cogs that are needed in the Clock Tower quest. Players must start the quest before they can access most of the dungeon.

Combat Training Camp.title: Combat Training Camp
Combat Training Camp.transport:
• Achievement diary cape to Two-pints, open the door and run north-west.
• Necklace of passage to The Outpost and run east.
• Spirit tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold exit the stronghold to the south, and run east.
• Ardougne Teleport to East Ardougne, run north, then run west, take the bridge south and run west past the Chaos Temple.
• Canoe Station just north of the camp.

Feldip Hills.title: Feldip Hills
Feldip Hills.transport:
A number of transportation options exist for travelling through the Feldip Hills:

Fairy rings:

Gu'Tanoth.title: Gu'Tanoth
Gu'Tanoth.transport:
Gu'Tanoth is an ogre city far south of Ardougne and slightly south-west of Yanille. Players need to progress far enough into the Watchtower quest in order to enter.

Some ogres here are aggressive to players.

Mudskipper Point.title: Mudskipper Point
Mudskipper Point.transport: Mudskipper Point is a small peninsula located in the south of the Kingdom of Asgarnia. It can be reached by journeying south past the coastal town of Port Sarim. After passing by the Rimmington Church, players will come to a small hut belonging to Thurgo, an Imcando dwarf. His hut contains an anvil, for smithing weapons, a hammock, a table and a chair. He plays a part in various quests and sells the Skillcape of Smithing. Next to him is a small hill with a trapdoor leading into the dangerous Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. If you continue south you will come to a small peninsula with a signpost reading

Bandit Camp mine.title: Bandit Camp mine
Bandit Camp mine.transport: The Bandit Camp mine (or the Hobgoblin Mine) is a mining site found north-east of the Bandit Camp in the Wilderness from levels 32 to 35 and east of the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. The mine is occupied by a large number of aggressive hobgoblins, from whom the mine gets its nickname.

Outpost.title: Outpost
Outpost.transport:
The Outpost lies just off the north-west corner of West Ardougne, and can be reached in a variety of ways.

Note: Many of the fast transport methods require the start or completion of various quests before they can be used.
• Necklace of passage
• Tree Gnome Stronghold locations:
• Spirit tree
• Balloon transport system
• Gnome glider
• Stronghold Slayer Cave teleport on the Slayer ring
• Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, take the level 37 Agility shortcut
• Teleports to the Ardougne area. From East Ardougne, players must walk north-west to exit the city and then west to the Outpost.
• Ardougne Teleport.
• Spirit tree to the Battlefield of Khazard.
• Eagle transport system to Eagles' Peak, then climbing down the eastern side of the mountain.
• Fairy ring fairy ring AKQ to the Piscatoris Hunter area, then walking east to use Kathy Corkat's rowboat to the southern part of the hunter area.

Lumbridge Swamp Caves.title: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
Lumbridge Swamp Caves.transport:
The Lumbridge Swamp Caves are a dungeon filled with a variety of monsters and Slayer monsters, located beneath Lumbridge Swamp.

There are three entrances to the caves:
• From the swamp near the candle seller, requiring a rope to enter. After one rope has been used, further ropes are not required.
• Directly south from the Lumbridge castle cellar. You must start The Lost Tribe to gain access this way. A pickaxe is needed to enter for the first time.
• From the minigame Tears of Guthix, which is in its own cave branching off from the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

The caves require a light source, unl

Silvarea.title: Silvarea
Silvarea.transport:
Several teleports bring players close to Silvarea, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

• Digsite pendant — Digsite, south-west of the area.
• Lumberyard teleport and ring of the elements — Lumberyard, west of Silvarea.
• Salve Graveyard Teleport, Fairy ring fairy ring CKS, and Slayer ring — Morytania, near the east end of Silvarea. With level 65 Agility, the ornate railing shortcut by the Paterdomus Temple allows quick passage between Morytania and Silvarea.

Graveyard of Heroes.title: Graveyard of Heroes
Graveyard of Heroes.transport:
The Graveyard of Heroes is located in the south-western part of Shayzien. The city's church is found here, and is filled with ceremonial pillars representing the soldiers who have perished in the line of duty. In the north-west corner, a gravestone with a rose engraved next to the lancalliums can be found. This gravestone belongs to Rose's mother, who died in childbirth.

Those who have added History and Hearsay to Kharedst's memoirs (Tale of the Righteous completion required) may teleport here using the book. On occasion, gang meetings take place here while players tackle organised crime.

A

Grand Tree mine.title: Grand Tree mine
Grand Tree mine.transport:
The Grand Tree mine is an area in the northern part of the Grand Tree Tunnels and is only accessible after The Grand Tree quest. Players can enter the mine after the quest by pushing the roots that block access from the central area. No axe or other equipment is required to push the roots aside.

Within the mine lie two slightly separated mining areas, one to the east and one to the west.

Mount Karuulm.title: Mount Karuulm
Mount Karuulm.transport:
Mount Karuulm can be reached by various methods:
• Directly teleporting to the volcano's summit via use of Rada's blessing 3 or 4.
• Rada's blessing 3 is limited to 3 teleports per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC, while Rada's blessing 4 provides unlimited teleports
• Using the fairy ring (code fairy ring CIR) and travelling up the volcano
• Casting Battlefront Teleport or using its magic tablet variant, and running north-west
• The skills necklace or Farming cape provide teleports to the nearby Farming Guild just south-west.
• The mountain itself can be climbed with 2 agility shortcuts, taking you halfway, then to the top of the mountain. (Agility levels 29 and 62 respectively.)

Shaman Caves.title: Shaman Caves
Shaman Caves.transport:
To navigate the caves after the quest (below 96 Agility), bring the following items:

The unpowered orb, runes, and a spade are not required to access the Death Wings.

To traverse the caves, the following steps must be taken:

• Enter the caves by searching the Rocks in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle.
• If you have at least 96 Agility and have completed Legends' Quest, use the shortcut on the western wall near the entrance of the cave. Skip to step 9.
• Search the eastern bookcase.
• Use a lockpick (note: a strange old lockpick will not work) on the Ancient Gate (click out of the dialogue if it states your lockpick breaks and try again)
• Smash the three boulders. (Level 52 mining require to smash boulders).
• Open the next Ancient Gate. (Level 50 strength require to attempt to move the metal doors).
• Jump-over the jagged wall.
• 'Use' the Marked wall on the west side of the room.
• Manually cast any Charge Orb spell on the northern Ancient Gate.
• Search, then Climb-down the winch.
• Climb-over several rocky ledges, or use the long rope shortcut (with 91 Agility).

Hosidius marketplace.title: Hosidius
Hosidius marketplace.transport:
• Teleport to House or a redirected teleport to house tablet.
• Xeric's talisman - Xeric's Glade Teleport, north-east of farming patch.
• Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the Dead - Lunch by the Lancalliums teleport (requires completion of The Depths of Despair).
• Kourend Castle Teleport - Run east past Kingstown then south after the bridge.
• Spirit tree planted in a spirit tree patch south-east of the Forthos Ruin.
• Skills necklace - North-east of the Woodcutting Guild teleport.
• Tithe Farm minigame teleport - Requires having entered the minigame at least once.
• Travel south of the Rusty Anchor Inn (and north of the Monks of Entrana) in Port Sarim and find Veos on the dock. Then right-click "Port Piscarilius Veos" (don't right-click "Land's End Veos"), run west on the dock of Port Piscarilius, keep running west until you get to a pub, then turn left and run south from Port Piscarilius to Hosidius.
• Fairy ring - fairy ring AKR to Hosidius Vinery, then run north-west.
• Sail and dock there with 5 Sailing, then run north.
• Teleport to Boat — Hosidius mooring point once player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus installed is docked there (requires 75 Sailing), then run north.

Crumbling Tower.title: Crumbling Tower
Crumbling Tower.transport:
The Crumbling Tower is a tower located on a small island off the north-west coast of Isle of Souls, which can be reached by using the fairy ring code fairy ring BJP and running westward. Several Forgotten Souls can be found on all three of the tower's floors. On the floor 1, a rope spawn can be found, and on the floor 2, a pestle and mortar spawns.

In the basement, players can find Dark Chests, which can only be opened with a dark key. Some bones, leather gloves, and a bronze pickaxe spawn down here as well. A few spiders also inhabit the basement.

A part of the basement wall, directly south

Death Altar.title: Death Altar
Death Altar.transport:
The entrance to the altar can be found on the bottom level of the Temple of Light. After completion of Mourning's End Part II, the altar can also be accessed through the Abyss.

To enter the mysterious ruins, players either have to use a death talisman on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a death tiara. Alternatively, a catalytic talisman or tiara can be used.

As the altar is one of the least-accessible in terms of distance from a bank, it's recommended to use the Abyss in order to craft a large amount of runes.

Additionally, the altar can be accessed via the Guardians of the Rift minigame. This can be a useful shortcut if wanting to access the altar quickly while avoiding the wilderness.

The Ruins:
Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the Temple of Light with a crystal trinket and using the following directions.

• Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
• Go south and up the staircase.
• Go to the centre of the temple.
• Climb down the next stairs twice.
• Rotate the mirror by selecting search on the pillar of light, to open the light door.
Note: When leaving, remember to rotate the mirror again for future visits.

The Underground Pass:
Alternatively, the Death Altar can be entered from the dwarven camp in the Underground Pass. This is also a way to enter this area if you have forgotten to rotate the mirror when exiting through the ruins. The run takes around 2 minutes and doesn't require a Crystal trinket, but does require partial…

Grave of Scorpius.title: Grave of Scorpius
Grave of Scorpius.transport: The easiest way to get to the Grave of Scorpius is via the Ourania Teleport spell. Otherwise, players can use a ring of dueling to teleport to Castle Wars and run north, or teleport to the Khazard Battlefield via the spirit tree (or Ardougne Cloak) and run west.

Revenant Caves.title: Revenant Caves
Revenant Caves.transport:
To get to the caves, players will have to traverse the Wilderness. Aside from simply walking there, there are some other options:
• Revenant cave teleport, which teleports the player to the level 40 entrance.
• Burning amulet, can take players to two entrances:
• Bandit Camp option - head east for the level 17 entrance.
• Lava Maze option - head east for the level 40 entrance.
• Wilderness Obelisks can take players to two entrances:
• Level 27 obelisk - head east to the level 26 entrance.
• Level 35 obelisk - head north-east to the level 40 entrance.
• Carrallanger Teleport, or the equivalent teleport tablet, takes players to the Graveyard of Shadows, close to the level 17 entrance.
• Canoeing to the Wilderness will take players close to the level 40 entrance.

West Ardougne.title: West Ardougne
West Ardougne.transport:
Several teleports bring players in or near West Ardougne, listed here with their teleport destinations:

• West Ardougne Teleport — city centre. This is the only direct teleport into West Ardougne.
• Ardougne Teleport — East Ardougne. From here, players then have several methods of entry:
• Through the pipe under Edmond's house (during and after Plague City. Unavailable after starting Biohazard).
• Via shortcut over the wall via Omart (during Plague City, before returning the distillator to Elena)
• Through the main gate from East Ardougne (after Plague City has been completed)
• Necklace of passage — the Outpost, north-west of the city.
• Coming from Tirannwn via the Underground Pass.

Lumbridge cow field.title: Lumbridge cow field
Lumbridge cow field.transport: The cowbell amulet can transport you to the middle of the field following the completion of the The Ides of Milk quest.

Fred's farm.title: Fred's farm
Fred's farm.transport: Fred's farm, also known as the Lumbridge farm, is a large farm in Lumbridge found north of the Lumbridge Castle. The farm is owned by Fred the Farmer, and is worked by Fred and several farmers.

Crafting Guild.title: Crafting Guild
Crafting Guild.transport:
In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:

• A skills necklace, Crafting cape, or max cape can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
• Players who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of one oak log.
• Players who have their player-owned house located in Rimmington can walk a short distance north-west to the Crafting Guild. Players with a tool store 3 can pick up a brown apron on their way.

South Falador Farm.title: South Falador Farm
South Falador Farm.transport:
• Use the Explorer's ring 2 and up from the Lumbridge & Draynor Diary to teleport to the farm's cabbage patch.
• Amulet of glory to Draynor Village then run west.
• Use Falador Teleport and run south to the farm.
• Charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.
• If players have their house in Rimmington, they can cast Teleport to House and run to the farm.
• If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
• If players have unlocked the Rat Pits, they can use the Minigame Teleport spell to Port Sarim and run north.

Ortus Farm.title: Ortus Farm
Ortus Farm.transport: The Ortus Farm is a farm to the west of Civitas illa Fortis. The farm has chickens, buffalos, and alpacas. Part of the Fortis Aqueduct also transports freshwater from Ralos' Rise to it.

Alice's farm.title: Alice's farm
Alice's farm.transport:
• Use the Ectophial to the Ectofuntus and run west
• Fairy ring code fairy ring ALQ and run north (be careful of level 61 Feral Vampyres)
• Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport from the Arceuus spellbook and run east
• Take a Charter ship to Port Phasmatys and run west

Ice Mountain.title: Ice Mountain
Ice Mountain.transport:
Players can walk there fairly easily from Falador (go north and north-east) and from the region of Barbarian Village and Edgeville (go west). Other transport routes to the mountain include:

• Lassar Teleport directly to the top of the mountain.
• Mind Altar Teleport north-west of the mountain, and run south-east.
• Use a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery and go south and west.
• Enter the Dwarven Mine from Falador (either directly or via the Mining Guild) and travel to the mine's exit on the mountain.
• Use the Keldagrim mine cart system to go to the Dwarven Mine and then exit onto the mountain. Players can enter the cart system in Keldagrim or in the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain.
• Use a skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village and then walk west to the mountain.
• Useful for Ironmen: Use the chronicle book, then using an axe cut a canoe behind the champions guild and travel to the Barbarian Village. From there Ice Mountain is a short run.

Ralos' Rise.title: Ralos' Rise
Ralos' Rise.transport:
• Pendant of Ates to Ralos' Rise (With the statue of ates unlocked at this location.)
• Quetzal Transport System to the Teomat. The Quetzal Transport System can be accessed in several ways:
• Ring of dueling to Fortis Colosseum and run west (this requires Hero status in the Colosseum)
• Hunter cape to Hunter Guild and run west
• Quetzal whistle
• Civitas illa Fortis Teleport and run north-east
• The east gate of Varrock
• Civitas illa Fortis Teleport and run west

Mons Gratia.title: Mons Gratia
Mons Gratia.transport:
Transport routes to the mountain include:
• Quetzal Transport System to Quetzacalli Gorge.

Lumbridge.title: Lumbridge
Lumbridge.transport:
Several transport options bring players into or close to Lumbridge, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
• Lumbridge Home Teleport — castle courtyard, once every 30 minutes. No Magic requirement or rune cost.
• Lumbridge Teleport — castle courtyard.
• Dying — castle courtyard (only if a respawn is set there). Players should bank items before doing this.
• The ring of returning and theRespawn Teleport spell work the same way.
• Canoe — Lumbridge canoe station.
• Amulet of glory — nearby Al Kharid or Draynor Village.
• Gnome glider — Al Kharid.
• Fairy code fairy ring DIP — Abyssal Nexus via the Appendage or fairy ring DIS — Wizard's Tower.
• Taking any fairy ring to Zanaris then leaving also leads to the Lumbridge shed.
• Cowbell amulet — inside the cow field.

Shortcuts:
• Broken raft - A grapple spot between Al Kharid and Lumbridge requiring 8 Agility, or 48 Agility without a grapple.

• Fence - A fence requiring 13 Agility.
• Stepping stone - A stepping stone providing quick access to the Kalphite lair, requiring 66 Agility.
The Al Kharid gate, found east of Lozar's house, connects Lumbridge to its neighbour city Al Kharid. Until the player has completed Prince Ali Rescue quest, it will cost 10 coins to pass either way through this gate to Al Kharid, though it can be avoided with a long detour north of the Groats' farm. Group Ironmen can find the portal to the Node on the north wall of the castle.

Dorgeshuun Mines.title: Dorgesh-Kaan mine
Dorgeshuun Mines.transport:
The Dorgesh-Kaan Mine (also known as Dorgeshuun Mines or Cave Goblin Mines), is used by the Dorgeshuun tribe of Cave goblins. The mine contains 9 iron ore rocks and 12 silver ore rocks, and it requires The Lost Tribe quest to be started to use. It can be accessed via the tunnels from the Lumbridge Castle cellar by going through the tunnel entrance and talking to or following Kazgar in the tunnel. (A player could retrace the route followed during The Lost Tribe, but this is unnecessary and dangerous.) The mine has the entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun underground city.

Although the mine

Observatory Dungeon.title: Observatory Dungeon
Observatory Dungeon.transport:
• Ring of dueling or minigame teleport to Castle Wars, then run north.
• Ourania Teleport, then run south.

Goblin Cave.title: Goblin Cave
Goblin Cave.transport:
The fastest methods to get to the Goblin Cave include:
• Using a plain of mud sphere to teleport directly inside the cave (requires Land of the Goblins)
• Using a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Fishing Guild and running east.
• Using the Fishing cape to teleport directly to the guild, and running east.
• Teleporting to Ardougne and running north (requires Plague City)
• Using the Ardougne cloak 2/3/4, teleport to the farming patch north of Ardougne and head west.

Goblin Village.title: Goblin Village
Goblin Village.transport:
Several transport options bring players into or close to Goblin Village, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
• Goblin Village teleport sphere — a random part of the village.
• Balloon transport system — Taverley, south-east of the village.
• Falador teleport — Falador square, well south of the village.
• Taverley teleport tablet or teleport to house — POH portal in Taverley. Requires a POH in Taverley to use.
• Mind Altar teleport — Mind Altar east of the village. Despite seeming close, it's a very long walk around to the village.

Tree Gnome Village maze.title: Gnome maze
Tree Gnome Village maze.transport:
• Spirit Tree teleport directly to the centre of the maze.
• Fairy ring to (fairy ring CIQ) and run west and then north.
• Ardougne cloak teleport to Ardougne Monastery and run west.
• Inside the city is a house portal, which can be reached with a House Teleport spell or tablet if your player-owned house is located in Yanille.
• A yanille tablet (made from using a scroll of redirection on a house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.
• Minigame teleport to fishing trawler and run west.
• Ardougne Teleport (tablet), run south.

Marim.title: Marim
Marim.transport:
Initial access to Marim requires the player to first travel to Ape Atoll via Lumdo on Crash Island during Monkey Madness I. To get there, speak to Daero on the floor 1 of the Grand Tree. From there, have Waydar fly you to Crash Island.

There are several alternative transportation methods available after completion of Monkey Madness I:
• A Fairy ring (fairy ring CLR) will take players to the Ape Atoll Agility Course, just south of Marim. 48 Agility and a ninja monkey greegree are required to exit the course safely and travel to Marim.
• The level 64 Ape Atoll Teleport is available in the normal spellbook after Freeing King Awowogei during Recipe for Disaster. The spell takes the player to the safe upstairs section of the Temple of Marimbo, on the eastern edge of Marim.
• The level 90 Ape Atoll Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook, as well as the equivalent magic tablet, takes players to the inside of the entrance to Ape Atoll Dungeon, a little ways south from the entrance gates to Marim.
• The Gnome glider network can take players to the western edge of Marim after completion of Monkey Madness II. The fastest way to access the glider network is by climbing to the top floor of the Grand Tree.

Mos Le'Harmless.title: Mos Le'Harmless
Mos Le'Harmless.transport:
You must complete Cabin Fever to access the island.

• Talk to Bill Teach on the eastern boat in Port Phasmatys. (Fastest way there is the ectophial.)
• Use the Minigame Teleport to Trouble Brewing (requires completion of the quest and 40 Cooking).
• Teleport to Harmony Island and talk to Brother Tranquility.
• Mos le'harmless teleport scrolls (brings you to the north gate).
• Charter ship (can be used once the quest is complete).
• Red or blue rum to teleport to Trouble Brewing (costs 20 pieces of eight each).

Temple of Marimbo.title: Temple of Marimbo
Temple of Marimbo.transport:
The Temple of Marimbo is a temple in Marim, Ape Atoll; it is dedicated to the monkey goddess, Marimbo. Marimbo takes the shape of a giant gorilla, yet she is a shapeshifter. The temple is only accessible during and after Monkey Madness I.

Players can use the temple for melee training without needing food or prayer potions, being able to top up their prayer at the nearby gorilla statue. Players may use Dharok the Wretched's set bonus along with the use of Protect from Melee to fight the Monkey Guards within, as they will only fight using melee. Using this method, players can keep their hitpoin

Corsair Cove.title: Corsair Cove
Corsair Cove.transport:
Players can be automatically ferried to the Cove by speaking to various NPCs. If The Corsair Curse is not started, players can speak with Captain Tock north of Port Sarim. Once started, players can speak to Captain Tock on the western end of Rimmington. Players can speak to Cabin Boy Colin in this same location after completing the quest. (To return to Rimmington, speak to Captain Tock during the quest, or Cabin Boy Colin post-quest aboard the ship at Corsair Cove.)

With The Corsair Curse completed, players with 40 Sailing can dock at the cove.

Other transport options which bring players into or close to Corsair Cove listed with their arrival destination, from closest to farthest:
• Charter ships — main docks.
• Teleport to Boat — Corsair Cove mooring point once a player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus is docked there (with 40 Sailing and The Corsair Curse completed)
• Spirit trees — Feldip Hills, south-west of the town.
• Mythical cape — Myths' Guild, west of the town, from the basement.
• Hunter cape or max cape — Feldip Hunter area, north of the town.
With 10 Agility, players can access Corsair Cove via the Feldip Hills by climbing the rocks south of the Feldip Hunter area. Players can also climb the rocks near the resource area with 30 Agility, after completion of Dragon Slayer I and having spoken to Haris.

Port Sarim.title: Port Sarim
Port Sarim.transport:
Several transport options bring players into or close to Port Sarim, listed here with their arrival destination.

• Spirit trees — northern Port Sarim.
• Charter ships — Port Sarim docks.
• Minigame Teleport — Rat Pits or Void Knights' Outpost. Usable once every 20 minutes.
• Pest control teleport — Void Knights' Outpost, where the squire can take players to Port Sarim for free.
• Explorer's ring 2 — the farm just north of the pub.
• Amulet of glory — Draynor Village, east of the port.
• Draynor Manor Teleport — Draynor Manor, north-east of the port.
• Ring of the elements — Air Altar entrance, north of the port.
• Teleport to House — Rimmington house portal. Requires a POH in Rimmington.
• Fairy ring fairy ring AIQ — Mudskipper Point, well south of the port.
• Falador Teleport — centre of Falador, well north of the port.
• Teleport to Boat — Port Sarim mooring point. Requires player-owned boat with a greater teleport focus installed docked at the gangplank.

Players can also get thrown into the holding cell at Shantay Pass and refuse to pay the fine for a one-way trip to the Port Sarim jail. Talk to Shantay and tell him you are an outlaw; once in Port Sarim jail, click the "pick-lock" option on the door to escape.
